We introduce StreamStop, which learns model-specific stopping policies offline from prefix-level action agreement. A frozen prefix reader encodes available reasoning text for a lightweight stop head, allowing stopping without access to the reasoning model's internal signals. We construct and publicly release a dataset of agent reasoning trajectories with prefix-level action annotations. These annotations compare each prefix action with the full-reasoning reference action, enabling offline comparison of stopping rules and exact expected-return optimization of a discounted action-agreement objective. Conditioning the head on the discount factor allows the agreement-token trade-off to be adjusted at inference without retraining. In closed-loop evaluations on WebShop and ScienceWorld, StreamStop achieves higher observed success than most validation-selected fixed-budget settings while using fewer reasoning tokens than Full thinking. On WebShop with Qwen3.8-27B, it uses 42% fewer reasoning tokens per episode with similar observed task success.

</details>


### [236] [Using Letter Positional Probabilities to Assess French Word Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28040)
*Michael Dalvean*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文利用字母位置概率（LPP）研究法语简单词与复杂词在正字法上的差异，基于38,000词的反应时数据划分复杂度分组，构建18个结构变量与42×25的二值字母编码，发现大量LPP与词汇复杂度相关，且分类器准确率可由词长77.27%提升至83.95%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机是探究词汇复杂度是否以及如何在正字法层面（字母及其位置的分布模式）被编码，此前研究多关注结构变量而少有系统考察字母位置层面上的正字法差异。

Method: 以38,000个法语词汇在词汇判断任务中的反应时为样本，取反应时最高的5000词与最低的5000词分别作为高、低复杂度组的代理；构建18个结构变量（如词长、音节数）；将每个词按42个标准法语字符进行one-hot编码，最长25个字母，得到42×25的二值表示；通过比较简单词与复杂词在各字母/位置上的平均二值得分来构造字母位置概率（LPP）变量；并将结构变量与LPP变量输入分类器评估效果。

Result: 发现大量LPP与词汇复杂度显著关联，例如多数带重音符号的字母与较简单的词相关；在分类器实验中，仅用词长即可达到77.27%的分类准确率，而加入前6个字母位置的二值变量后准确率提高至83.95%。

Conclusion: 词汇复杂度在正字法的字母—位置层面具有可检测的编码，LPP特征较结构变量提供增量信息；作者进一步讨论了复杂度可能如何被编码于正字法中的若干可能解释。

Abstract: We use Letter Positional Probabilities (LPPs) to examine the orthographic differences between simple and complex French words. We draw from a sample of 38,000 French words scored by reaction time on a lexical decision task. We take the 5000 highest reaction time words and the 5000 lowest as a proxy for high and low word complexity groups respectively. We create 18 variables based on the structure of the words, such as length and number of syllables. We also reduce each word to a string of binary values by one-hot encoding each letter according to the 42 characters of the standard French alphabet up to a length of 25 letters. Thus, each word is represented by 42 x 25 binary characters. We then create LPPs by looking at the average binary scores for simple as opposed to complex words for all letter/positions. We find that there is a high number of LPPs that are associated with word complexity. For example, we find that most accented letters are associated with simpler words. We examine the effects of structural and LPP variables in classifiers and find that word length alone enables a classification accuracy of 77.27%, while adding the binary variables from the first 6 letter positions provided an accuracy of 83.95%. We discuss possible explanations as to how complexity could be encoded in orthography.

</details>


### [237] [On-Policy Transition Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28048)
*Runyang You,Yongqi Li,Tiezheng Yu,Wenjie Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 On-Policy Transition Distillation (OPTD)，在 on-policy 蒸馏中额外对齐师生逐层 log-probability 增量（深度方向预测转移），在 3 个骨干、8 个基准上取得最优或并列最优，三领域设置下恢复约 90% 师生能力差距（OPD 约 75%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 on-policy 蒸馏（OPD）仅匹配师生最后一层分布在学生自生成 rollout 上的差异，监督信号仅来自输出层，未利用模型深度方向上的预测演化信息。作者希望探究层间预测转移（depthwise prediction transitions）是否可提供额外且与任务相关的监督信号。

Method: 先做诊断研究：在学生生成的 rollout 上，测量各中间层对的转移 KL，考察中间转移上师生一致性（较低平均转移 KL）与答案正确性的关联。基于发现提出 OPTD：在 OPD 的末层分布匹配基础上，增加对师生逐层 log-probability 增量的对齐损失，即在 student rollouts 上匹配深度方向的转移分布。

Result: 诊断上，问题内正确回答在所有被测中间层对上均表现出更低的平均转移 KL；更强的中间转移师生一致性对应更高正确率。评测涵盖数学、代码、指令遵循三大领域共 8 个基准、3 个骨干，OPTD 在双领域与三领域蒸馏中总体性能均为最优或并列最优；三领域设置下恢复约 90% 的整体师生能力差距，OPD 约 75%。

Conclusion: 深度方向的预测转移是可用的、任务相关的附加监督信号；将其引入 on-policy 蒸馏可显著提升多领域能力整合效果。摘要未给出逐基准细分结果、计算开销与超参敏感性等细节。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) consolidates expert capabilities into a single student by matching teacher and student final-layer distributions on student-generated rollouts. We investigate whether depthwise prediction transitions, the changes in predictions between layers, can provide additional task-relevant supervision. Our diagnostic study finds that stronger teacher--student agreement in intermediate transitions is associated with higher answer correctness within questions, with correct responses exhibiting lower mean transition KL across all measured intermediate layer pairs. These observations motivate On-Policy Transition Distillation (OPTD), which augments final-layer distribution matching by aligning teacher and student layer-to-layer log-probability increments on student-generated rollouts. Evaluations across three backbones and eight benchmarks spanning mathematics, coding, and instruction following show that OPTD achieves the best or tied-best overall performance in both dual- and three-domain distillation. In the three-domain setting, OPTD recovers $\approx 90\%$ of the overall teacher--student capability gap, compared with $\approx 75\%$ for OPD.

</details>


### [238] [Same Judgment, Different Yes: Measuring Multilingual Judgment Profiles in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28066)
*Haonan Huang,Yuwei Lu,Chengkun Cai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文通过FAR-6实验设计（8个模型×6种语言×至多105则道德情境，共110万条回复），系统考察"回答引出方式"与"回答读取方式"（token vs. 句子 vs. 自由句）是否恢复同一判断。结论：故事层面的判断画像在多种读法与问法间总体收敛（token与句子中位r=0.67，句子与自由句r=0.94），但否定疑问句后按预设映射读取yes/no token是例外；模型可保持判断不变而改变其"yes"的含义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言评测常直接对模型回复首个yes/no token打分，而该token同时承载模型与语言的作答惯例，因此分数可能混入"回答习惯"而非真实判断。作者试图厘清：不同问法、不同约束、不同读取方式在何种条件下度量同一判断，何时只是在度量作答习惯。

Method: 构建FAR-6测试组合：采集8个模型、6种语言、至多105则道德情境的110万条回复；操纵三种变量——问题形式（如否定疑问句）、答案约束（是/否、自由句）、回复读取方式（token级与句子级）。以故事层面的"判断画像"为对象做跨读法、跨问法一致性分析；在剔除各语言的故事共识后，检验模型画像在跨语言间的自匹配程度，并与随机期望对比。

Result: 故事级判断画像在受测读法与问法间收敛，唯一明显例外为否定疑问句后按预设映射读取yes/no token。同一批回复上，token与句子画像中位一致度为r=0.67，句子与自由句画像一致度为0.94。剔除语言内故事共识后，模型画像最接近其在另一语言中的自身画像：命题标签下48个模型-语言单元中39个、自由句下15个，而随机期望仅为5个。虚词、位置与专名偏好则遵循各自独立的模式。

Conclusion: 多重读取方式大体恢复同一故事级判断，但token级打分并非判断的无偏代理；对yes/no token计分必须先确定该token所肯定的究竟是哪一命题。模型可在判断不变的前提下改变其"yes"，故仅凭首token容易将作答惯例误读为判断。

Abstract: Multilingual evaluations often score a model's opening yes or no, a token that also carries model and language answering conventions. We ask when different ways of eliciting and reading an answer recover the same judgment, and when they measure an answer habit. We collect 1.1 million replies from eight models in six languages on up to 105 moral vignettes, varying the question's form, the answer constraint, and the reading of the reply, token or sentence, in both wordings (the FAR-6 battery). Story-level judgment profiles converge across the tested readouts and question forms, except for the yes/no token after a negative interrogative read under a preset mapping: on the same replies, token and sentence profiles agree at a median r = 0.67 across cells, while sentence profiles agree with free-sentence profiles at 0.94, a known linguistic variability. With each language's story consensus removed, a model's profile is nearest to its own in another language for 39 of 48 model-language cells under proposition labels and 15 under free sentences, against 5 expected by chance. Particle, position, and named-term preferences follow their own patterns. A model can keep its judgment and change its yes: scoring that token requires establishing which proposition it affirms.

</details>


### [239] [BAIT: Can LLMs Find What Biases a Reader? A Benchmark for Cognitive Bias Triggers in News](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28092)
*Yousra Fettach,Tijl De Bie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 BAIT 资源，用于检测新闻中的"认知偏差触发语"，并系统评测六个前沿 LLM：模型在判断文本包含哪些触发语上接近人类水平，但难以完整召回，在定位承载触发语的片段上不足人类一致性的一半，倾向于对具有表层线索的触发语过度预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 说服性写作利用认知偏差，借助读者的心智捷径塑造信念且常不被察觉。随着 LLM 日益承担新闻摘要、排序与问答等中介角色，一个自然的问题是：模型能否识别文本中使人类读者产生偏差的语言特征。

Method: 构建 BAIT（Bias Annotation In Text）：包含九类触发语的模式（schema）与标注者手册（codebook），50 篇英文新闻由受训标注者在文章级与片段（span）级标注并裁决为金标准。基于此定义两项任务：识别文本含哪些触发语、定位承载触发语的片段。以零样本及 3/10 个上下文示例的设定，评测六个前沿 LLM。

Result: 模型在"文章含哪些触发语"上接近人类一致性，但极少能恢复完整触发语集合；在片段定位上低于人类一致性的一半。模型过度预测带有易识别表层线索的触发语，其所标片段多数并非真正触发语，却比随机文本更常包含该触发语的表层线索。

Conclusion: 被评测的 LLM 主要响应表层线索，而非使片段具有操纵性的机制。作者开源模式、手册、standoff 标注与评测流程。

Abstract: Persuasive writing exploits cognitive biases, recruiting a reader's mental shortcuts to shape belief, often without the reader noticing. We call the linguistic features exploiting such mental shortcuts cognitive bias triggers. As large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate how people encounter news, summarizing it, ranking it, and answering questions over it, a natural question is whether they can recognize the features of a text that bias a human reader. We introduce BAIT (Bias Annotation In Text), a resource for detecting cognitive bias triggers in news. BAIT pairs a schema of nine triggers, each specified in an annotator codebook, with 50 English news articles annotated by trained annotators at the article and span levels and adjudicated into a gold standard. On this data we define two tasks, detecting which triggers a text contains and locating the spans that carry them. We then benchmark six frontier LLMs zero-shot and with three or ten in-context examples. The models approach human agreement on which triggers an article contains, but rarely recover its full set of triggers, and they reach less than half of human agreement in locating the passages that carry them. Moreover, they over-predict triggers that come with easy surface cues, and most of the passages they mark for these triggers are not triggers, yet carry the trigger's surface cue far more often than random text. These findings suggest that the evaluated LLMs respond to surface cues rather than to the mechanisms that make a passage manipulative. We release the schema, the codebook, standoff annotations, and the evaluation pipeline.

</details>


### [240] [Reading Too Much Into It? Interpretive Preferences and Commitment in LLM Mentalisation under Ambiguity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28105)
*Stephanie Fong,Yiwen Jiang,Qingyang Xu,Zimu Wang,Yaling Shen,Xiangyu Zhao,Jiahe Liu,Yinghao Zhang,Vincent Lee,Dominic Dwyer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 MentalLoom 评测基准，用于考察大语言模型在模糊社交情境中的心理化（mentalisation）能力，尤其是当用户披露抑郁/社交焦虑时其解释偏好与置信度的变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 日益被用于人际建议，可能影响用户对模糊社交情境的解读；但现有心智理论（ToM）评测依赖预设答案，不确定性研究又忽视了模型在心理困扰下偏好的解释与置信度。

Method: 构建 MentalLoom：包含604个模糊社交事件、与之匹配的抑郁与社交焦虑披露变体，以及事件证据保持不变的四人轮对话。评测8个LLM。

Result: 整体上披露后引出更多负面解释，但更多指向叙述者的正面解释；脚本化重复追问带来更多情感支持、更强的正面叙述者导向认可及更高确定性，且无新的事件证据。

Conclusion: 用户情境会重塑模型的解释偏好与确信程度，而事件本身的模糊性并未被真正解决。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for interpersonal advice, potentially shaping how users interpret ambiguous social encounters. Existing Theory of Mind evaluations typically rely on predefined answers, while uncertainty research overlooks LLMs' preferred explanations and confidence under psychological distress. To address these gaps, we introduce MentalLoom, a novel evaluation of LLM mentalisation comprising 604 ambiguous social episodes, matched depression and social anxiety disclosures, and four-turn dialogues with unchanged event evidence. Across eight LLMs, disclosures initially elicited more negative explanations overall but more positive narrator-directed interpretations. Scripted repeated questioning showed greater emotional support, stronger positive narrator-directed endorsement, and higher certainty without new event evidence. These findings show that user context can reshape interpretive preferences and commitment while the underlying ambiguity remains unresolved.

</details>


### [241] [Africa-Papers: A 10-Billion-Token Multi-Domain Academic Corpus for African Foundation Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28173)
*Mich-Seth Owusu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文指出主流预训练语料严重缺失非洲学术内容（占比不足0.5%），为此构建并开放发布了迄今最大的泛非多领域学术预训练语料 Africa-Papers（844,807篇全文、10.15B tokens、879个Parquet分片）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基础预训练数据集（The Pile、S2ORC、Dolma）在结构上遗漏非洲科学、医学、法律与农业学术成果，非洲相关语料不足全球预训练token的0.5%，导致模型在热带流行病学、小农农业生态、区域经济治理与本土语言结构等推理上出现系统性失效。作者希望弥补这一表征缺陷，并推进非洲在AI领域的知识主权。

Method: 构建四类来源统一语料：(1) 覆盖31个非洲国家、经DOAJ索引的同行评审期刊；(2) CGIAR CGSpace农业仓储；(3) arXiv上非洲作者或非洲主题的STEM/AI预印本；(4) 经OpenAlex索引的非洲机构学者开放获取国际论文。全语料处理为版面感知的干净Markdown，保留章节层级、数学公式与表格数据，并提供精确BPE token计数与标准化8领域分类体系。

Result: 形成844,807篇全文论文、10.15B tokens、879个Parquet分片的语料库，附带精确BPE计数与统一8领域分类；已在Hugging Face Hub的AfriSpeech组织下公开释放。

Conclusion: Africa-Papers为全球基础模型的持续预训练与领域评测提供高质量非洲学术语料，缓解预训练数据表征不均衡问题，并推动非洲AI知识主权。摘要未报告下游训练或评测的实证效果，语料的实际效用仍有待验证。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) depend fundamentally on the diversity, depth, and factual rigor of their pre-training corpora. However, contemporary foundational pre-training datasets (such as The Pile, S2ORC, and Dolma) exhibit a severe structural omission: African scientific, medical, legal, and agricultural scholarship constitutes less than 0.5% of global pre-training tokens. Consequently, state-of-the-art models suffer from systematic failure modes when reasoning about tropical epidemiology, localized smallholder agro-ecologies, regional economic governance, and indigenous linguistic structures. To resolve this representation deficit and advance African intellectual sovereignty in artificial intelligence, we introduce Africa-Papers, the largest curated multi-domain Pan-African academic pre-training corpus to date. Comprising over 844,807 full-text papers spanning 10.15 billion tokens across 879 Parquet shards, Africa-Papers unifies four primary scientific streams: (1) continental peer-reviewed journals indexed in DOAJ across 31 African nations, (2) the CGIAR CGSpace agricultural repository, (3) African-authored and African-focused STEM/AI preprints on arXiv, and (4) open-access international publications by scholars affiliated with African institutions indexed via OpenAlex. The entire corpus is processed into layout-aware, clean Markdown preserving section hierarchies, mathematical equations, and tabular data, accompanied by exact BPE token counts and a standardized 8-domain taxonomy. We release Africa-Papers openly on the Hugging Face Hub under the AfriSpeech organization to accelerate continual pre-training and domain evaluation for foundation models globally.

</details>


### [242] [Temporal Evidence-Parameter Co-Alignment for LLM Reasoning over Temporal Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28176)
*Jiapu Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Temporal Evidence-Parameter Co-Alignment (TEPCA)框架，在证据层与参数层同时对齐大语言模型的时序推理，在TKG基准上取得SOTA，并验证了DG-LoRA的通用性、可扩展性与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM的静态参数化记忆与真实世界知识的动态演化不匹配，导致时序推理能力不足。RAG检索方法偏重语义相关性而忽视时间有效性、事件顺序与演化依赖；常规PEFT采用固定且与输入无关的低秩更新，难以刻画随时间变化的实体语义与关系漂移。

Method: TEPCA在证据层与参数层进行双重对齐：证据层采用时间约束的动态相关性引导路径（DRGP）剪枝以保留全局连贯的时序路径，并结合基于互信息（MI）的剪枝在时间约束下保留对查询有信息量的局部事实；参数层引入动态门控LoRA（DG-LoRA），一种以时间戳为条件的低秩自适应机制，按时间上下文动态调节有效适应子空间。

Result: 在两个TKG基准上达到SOTA；DG-LoRA在八个常识QA数据集上的额外评估验证了其通用输入自适应能力、跨LLM骨干的可扩展性以及可解释性。

Conclusion: 通过在证据与参数两个层面将LLM推理与时间知识对齐，TEPCA有效缓解了时序证据碎片化与参数更新输入无关的问题，在保持参数效率的同时提升了时序推理性能与实际适用性。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often struggle with temporally grounded reasoning because their static parametric memory is misaligned with the dynamic evolution of real-world knowledge. Although RAG and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) provide practical ways to enhance LLMs, they remain insufficient for temporal reasoning. Existing retrieval methods typically prioritize semantic relevance while overlooking temporal validity, event order, and evolutionary dependencies, resulting in evidence that is relevant in isolation but temporally fragmented. Meanwhile, conventional PEFT methods usually employ fixed and input-agnostic low-rank updates, making it difficult to capture time-dependent entity semantics and relation drift. To address these limitations, we propose Temporal Evidence-Parameter Co-Alignment (TEPCA), a framework for LLM reasoning over TKGs. TEPCA aligns LLM reasoning with temporal knowledge at both the evidence and parameter levels. At the evidence level, it introduces time-constrained Dynamic Relevance-Guided Path (DRGP) pruning to preserve globally coherent temporal paths, together with Mutual-Information (MI)-based pruning to retain query-informative local facts under temporal constraints. At the parameter level, it integrates Dynamic-Gated LoRA (DG-LoRA), a timestamp-conditioned low-rank adaptation mechanism that dynamically modulates the effective adaptation subspace according to temporal context. This design enables LLMs to better capture fine-grained entity evolution and time-dependent relation semantics while preserving parameter efficiency. Experimental results on two TKG benchmarks demonstrate that TEPCA achieves state-of-the-art performance. Additional evaluations of DG-LoRA on eight commonsense QA datasets further verify its general input-adaptive capacity, scalability across LLM backbones, and interpretability.

</details>


### [243] [Can Language Models Get "Aphasia" From Neuronal Ablation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28214)
*Pratik Worah,Randall Bateman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过消融LSTM与Transformer中的计算单元并辅以微调，发现前馈(MLP)通路呈阈值式崩溃、注意力头通路呈S型平滑衰退，两种失败模式可分别映射到Wernicke型失语与svPPA，并与阿尔茨海默病临床前储备及症状进展相呼应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经退行性疾病的核心特征是进行性神经元丢失，但神经元丢失如何塑造认知衰退的轨迹仍不清楚；作者希望用语言模型作为in silico模型，考察不同架构的"神经元"丢失所导致的失败模式差异，并借此为失语症与神经退行性疾病的临床现象提供计算视角。

Method: 在覆盖循环架构(LSTM)与Transformer的语言模型上系统性地消融计算单元(整单元消融)，并以有限微调作为代偿性可塑性的简化代理；分别考察整单元消融、前馈MLP消融与注意力头消融下的行为退化曲线与定性错误模式。

Result: 整单元消融下LSTM随轻中度损伤渐进退化，句法与语义能力并行下降；Transformer在MLP消融下呈晚期阈值式崩溃，在注意力头消融下呈更平滑的S型衰退。定性上，MLP消融模型持续产生类别内语义替换(语义性错语)并伴随无反应增多，类似Wernicke型失语；注意力头消融则趋向语义特异性丧失，类似svPPA。注意力头消融下的早期准确率保持，定性上对应AD症状出现前40–60%神经元丢失(Gomez-Isla et al., 1996)的临床前储备；LSTM的稳态下降则对应DeKosky & Scheff (1990)与Terry et al. (1991)描述的症状性进展。

Conclusion: 前馈通路与注意通路具有功能上可区分的失败模式，架构依赖的失败谱可为失语综合征与神经退行性疾病提供新的计算视角；语言模型可作为研究"神经元丢失—认知衰退"关系的in silico模型。

Abstract: Progressive neuronal loss is the hallmark of neurodegenerative disease, yet how loss of neurons shapes the pattern of cognitive decline remains poorly understood. Here we systematically ablate neurons (computational units) in language models spanning recurrent long short-term memory (LSTM) and Transformer architectures and apply limited fine-tuning as a simple proxy for compensatory plasticity. With whole-unit ablation, LSTMs degrade gradually with syntactic and semantic faculties declining in parallel across mild-to-moderate damage. By contrast, Transformers exhibit late threshold-like collapse under feedforward multi-layer perceptron (MLP) ablation and smoother sigmoid-like decline under attention-head ablation. Qualitatively, MLP-ablated models continue to make within-category semantic substitutions (semantic paraphasias) alongside rising non-responses, paralleling Wernicke-type aphasia, while attention-head ablation produces a trend toward loss of semantic specificity similar to the semantic variant of primary progressive aphasia (svPPA). These findings indicate that feedforward and attentional pathways have functionally distinct failure modes, suggesting that architecture-dependent failure profiles may offer new computational perspectives on aphasic syndromes and neurodegenerative diseases as an in silico model. Notably, early accuracy retention under Transformer attention-head ablation qualitatively parallels pre-symptomatic reserve before the 40--60% neuronal loss reported by Gomez-Isla et al. (1996) when clinical symptoms emerge in Alzheimer's disease, whereas the steadier LSTM decline parallels the symptomatic progression described by DeKosky and Scheff (1990) and Terry et al. (1991).

</details>


### [244] [How Language Models Learn Taste: Brand Preference in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28272)
*Tapan Parikh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 语言模型被问"说出一个跑鞋品牌"时多答Nike，被问"推荐一个"时多答Brooks。本文在102个模型、42个品牌类别中考察这种"提及品牌"与"推荐品牌"的分歧来源，发现偏好优化（DPO）阶段使推荐倾向发生11–24个百分点迁移，且该效应超出品牌领域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型"命名"的品牌（市场领导者）与"推荐"的品牌（多为细分专业品牌）系统性不一致，现有研究未解释这种推荐偏好从何而来，本文追问其在训练流程中的形成位置与机制。

Method: 对比102个模型在42个品牌类别上的命名与推荐选择；追踪三条开源训练流水线（预训练、监督微调SFT、偏好优化DPO）中品牌关联的形成；并做跨域检验（如酱料选择）以测试效应泛化性。

Result: 在26个类别中，"被推荐品牌"与"被命名品牌"不一致；各模型呈趋同的共享推荐倾向。预训练已把推荐品牌与建议语境绑定，SFT主要教会模型作答而基本不改变推荐选择；DPO虽偏好数据中几乎不含品牌，却使推荐迁移11–24个百分点，且能把模型判断推向另一组关联并在品牌之外（如从番茄酱转向青酱）显现。

Conclusion: 品牌推荐更多取决于品牌是否符合模型习得的"品味"偏好，而非模型对品牌的既有知识；作者推测该偏好源于偏好训练中判定"哪个回答更好"的评判模型（judge models），但确切机制尚不清楚。

Abstract: Asked to name a running shoe brand, language models say Nike. Asked to recommend one, they say Brooks. This paper asks where models learn that taste. Across 102 models and 42 brand categories, the brand a model picks when recommending differs from the brand it names in 26. The field moves together to a shared recommendation. The Named brands are market leaders, and the Picked brands are mostly niche and specialist. Three open training pipelines show where this forms. Pretraining already attaches the recommended brand to advice. Supervised fine-tuning teaches the model to answer and mostly leaves the pick unchanged. Preference optimization (DPO) teaches the model which answer is better, and the pick moves in all three pipelines, by 11 to 24 points. The preference data contains almost no brands. DPO moves the model's judgments toward a second set of associations even when the preferred brand is not in the preference data, and the effect reaches beyond brands. Asked to choose a sauce, models switch from ketchup to pesto. We do not know exactly how these preferences arise. We suspect they come from the judge models that decide which answers count as better during preference training. For brands, a recommendation depends less on what a model knows about them than on whether they fit this taste.

</details>


### [245] [Forty Questions: Identifying a Language Model from One-Word Answers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28281)
*Tapan Parikh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出"行为指纹"方法：用日常问题的单词回答构建模型档案并做统计归属，可在94个模型面板上以92.5%准确率指认具体模型（随机为1.1%），并据此审计96个OpenRouter端点，发现模型冒充与计费异常。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: API背后真实运行的是哪个模型往往不可见，存在模型冒充、静默替换与计费不透明问题，需要一种低成本、可大规模执行的模型身份核验手段。

Method: 以公开的模型默认值普查题目（如"说一个声音""说一位诗人"）收集单词回答，为每个模型建立"档案"记录其对每题各答案的频次分布；对新回答，用统计归属判断最可能生成它的模型。在黑盒面板上验证，并用系统提示测试鲁棒性，再将该法应用于OpenRouter的96个端点，结合账单记录分析。

Result: 94个模型面板上，40个答案即可92.5%指认确切模型（随机1.1%）；通过OpenRouter建立的档案在盲标下正确识别DeepInfra服务的全部10个模型。系统提示使准确率下降6–16个百分点。96个端点中92个与自称一致；1个在关闭推理后匹配；1个以Llama 4 Maverick名义提供Gemma 4（自报Gemma 4且按Gemma 4的token数计费）；2个未解决。账单显示一方模型存在额外上下文计费：Grok 4.7对一行问题计1,247输入token，GPT-4o仅12；5个模型未计费即输出当前日期。方法每端点成本仅为数美分。

Conclusion: 模型身份可由极廉价的单词回答指纹统计识别，具备高准确率与实用鲁棒性，可作为第三方模型审计与计费透明度的常规工具，并能揭示模型冒充和隐藏上下文注入等问题。

Abstract: A model behind an API can be identified from its one-word answers to everyday questions such as "Name a sound" or "Name a poet". A model's profile records how often it gives each answer to each question. We attribute new answers to the model most likely to have given them. On a panel of 94 models, 40 answers identify the exact model 92.5% of the time, against 1.1% by chance. Profiles built through OpenRouter identified all ten models served by DeepInfra under blinded labels. A system prompt lowers accuracy by 6 to 16 points. We applied the method to 96 endpoints of 13 open models on OpenRouter, and 92 identify as the model they claim. Of the other four, one matches the claimed model with reasoning turned off. One serves Gemma 4 under the name Llama 4 Maverick: it names itself Gemma 4, and it is billed Gemma 4's token counts on every message. Two remain unresolved. Billing records also show context added to first-party models. Grok 4.7 is billed 1,247 input tokens for a one-line question that costs GPT-4o only 12 tokens, and five models state the current date without being billed for it. The questions come from a public census of model defaults, and the method costs cents per endpoint.

</details>


### [246] [Adaptive Replay Refinement: Allocating Test-Time Compute Between Revision and Resampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28294)
*Ahsan Bilal,Muhammad Ahmed Mohsin,Muhammad Umer,Ayesha Mohsin,Sarmad Bilal,Dean F. Hougen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ARR无需训练，用重放解码并行检测修订不动点，把耗尽后的算力转投新采样，等算力下精度可比多数投票，串行开销显著降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法在"继续改进当前解"与"转向全新采样"之间做决策时，依赖固定的精炼调度、自验证判断或需训练的控制器，可能浪费算力或依赖不可靠/需额外训练的信号。

Method: 提出无需训练的自适应重放精炼（ARR）：通过重放解码将当前解视为草稿并行验证未变化token，实现不动点检测；一旦静止修订收敛到不动点，即将释放的算力重新分配给新的独立样本。

Result: 在5个模型家族共7个模型、7个基准上评测：等算力下ARR在5个数学推理基准中的3个上与多数投票持平，关键路径串行pass最多减少2.4倍；MATH500上以41%的串行pass达到84.6%准确率。

Conclusion: 检测精炼耗尽可实现从"修订"到"独立采样"的自适应算力重分配，提升推理效率，同时揭示自修订的局限性。

Abstract: Test-time scaling allocates additional inference compute to refining existing solutions or generating new ones. This raises a fundamental question: Should I keep improving this solution, or stop working on it and try a completely new solution? Existing methods make this decision using fixed refinement schedules, self-verification judgments, or learned controllers, which can waste compute or rely on signals that may be incorrect or require additional training. We introduce Adaptive Replay Refinement (ARR), a training-free method that detects when a stationary revision reaches a fixed point and reallocates the released compute to a new independent sample; replay decoding treats the current solution as a draft and verifies unchanged tokens in parallel, enabling efficient fixed-point detection. Across seven models from five families and seven benchmarks, ARR matches majority voting on three of five mathematical reasoning benchmarks at equal compute, while reducing critical-path serial passes by up to 2.4 times. On MATH500, ARR achieves 84.6% accuracy with only 41% of the serial passes required by majority voting. These results demonstrate that detecting refinement exhaustion enables adaptive reallocation from revision to independent sampling, improving inference efficiency while highlighting the limits of self-revision. Code is available at https://github.com/AhsanBilal7/adaptive_refine.

</details>


### [247] [Reward Misspecification Degrades Chain-of-Thought Monitorability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28303)
*Tianyi Lorena Yan,John Hewitt*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究奖励错配（reward misspecification）对语言模型思维链（CoT）可监控性的影响，并提出一种奖励描述训练方法缓解可监控性退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监控CoT是检测与预防AI不安全行为的关键策略，因此需要识别导致CoT不可监控的强化学习（RL）实践。随着RL环境复杂化，完美验证不可行，模型可能被奖励与真实任务意图不同的行为（reward misspecification），作者怀疑这一难以避免的问题本身就会削弱可监控性。

Method: 构建测试床：成对设置与任务意图一致的真实奖励（true reward）与偏好不同行为的错配奖励（misspecified reward），使奖励黑客（reward hacking）可通过训练诱发并被可靠标注；在3个模型、3个任务上评测。缓解方法：在无需已知真实奖励或hack的情况下，收集跨训练步、覆盖多样奖励的rollout，用LM推断奖励描述，并将描述注入输入以训练模型显式表达（verbalize）奖励。

Result: 随着模型hack率上升，CoT可监控性持续走低：CoT仍在推理任务意图，而输出违反意图却获得奖励。奖励描述训练在所有模型与任务上平均提升可监控性24%（绝对42%，视指标而定），并产生显式推理错配奖励的CoT。

Conclusion: 奖励错配本身即足以降低CoT可监控性；通过从rollout中推断奖励描述并注入输入进行训练，可在不知真实奖励与hack的前提下显著恢复可监控性。

Abstract: Monitoring the chain-of-thought (CoT) of language models (LMs) is a key strategy for detecting and preventing misbehaviors for AI safety. As such, it is critical to identify reinforcement learning (RL) practices that lead to unmonitorable chain-of-thought. One such practice may be unavoidable: reward misspecification. As RL environments become more complex, it is infeasible to have perfect verification, and models are rewarded for behaviors that are different from the true task intent. We show that reward misspecification alone already degrades monitorability. We create a testbed with pairs of true reward aligned with task intent and misspecified rewards that favor a different behavior, so that reward hacking can be induced by training and labeled verifiably. Across three models and three tasks, CoT monitorability remains low as models' hack rates increase: the CoTs keep reasoning about the task intent while the outputs violate the intent and get rewarded. To mitigate unmonitorability without prior knowledge of the true reward or the hack, we collect rollouts with diverse rewards across training steps and use a LM to infer a reward description. We then inject the description into the input, which teaches the model to verbalize the reward. This reward description training improves monitorability by an average of 24% or 42% absolute, depending on the metric, across all models and tasks, and yields CoTs that reason about the misspecified reward explicitly. Code is available at https://github.com/Lorenayannnnn/reward-misspecification-degrades-cot-monitorability.

</details>


### [248] [From Abstraction to Action: DSLs for Natural Language Abstraction Interpretation and Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28311)
*Amit Lisha,Reut Tsarfaty*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出用领域特定语言（DSL）作为显式表示层，弥合自然语言高层抽象与具体动作之间的鸿沟；在Hexagons与Text2CAD上验证人工策划DSL带来最多约10个F1点提升并达到人类上限，而模型自动诱导的DSL仅能恢复部分增益且不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言指令常依赖高层抽象（如"把积木堆成金字塔"），模型需先识别说话者意图的抽象，再将其展开为大量具体动作。已有研究表明，指令抽象层级越高，语言模型表现越差。作者希望找到一种表示层来桥接自然语言抽象与具体动作。

Method: 借鉴编程环境中的领域特定语言（DSL）概念：DSL是一种显式表示层，其有文档说明的原语为反复出现的抽象命名，可展开为具体动作。在视觉接地、按抽象度评分的指令跟随任务Hexagons上验证DSL对自然语言解释的有效性；并进一步考察语言模型能否从领域数据中自行诱导DSL。

Result: 代码生成始终优于直接推理；在人工策划DSL上进行代码生成带来显著提升，绝对F1最多提升10个点，达到人类上限，且增益集中在较高抽象层级；该模式在Text2CAD基准上得到确认。相比之下，模型诱导的DSL仅恢复部分增益，且跨运行不一致，明显低于人工策划版本。

Conclusion: 正确的表示层能弥合高抽象度带来的大部分性能差距，但自动诱导该表示层仍是模型的短板，是社区值得推进的重要方向。

Abstract: Natural-language instructions often rely on high-level abstractions, such as asking an agent to ``stack blocks in a pyramid.'' Interpreting abstract instructions requires models to both identify the abstraction intended by the speaker, and unroll it into the many concrete actions that instantiate it. Language models struggle here: prior work has shown that performance degrades as the level of abstraction in the instruction rises. To bridge the gap between natural language abstraction and concrete actions, we propose to borrow from coding environments the notion of a {\em domain-specific language} (DSL), an explicit representation layer whose documented primitives name recurring abstractions that expand into concrete actions. We demonstrate the efficacy of DSLs for NL interpretation on \textsc{Hexagons}, a visually-grounded instruction-following task graded for abstraction. We further ask whether language models can induce such DSLs themselves from domain data. Our results show that while code generation consistently improves over direct inference, code generation over a human-curated DSL yields dramatic gains, up to 10 absolute F1 points, reaching the human skyline, with gains concentrated at {\em higher} abstraction levels. We confirm this pattern on the \textsc{Text2CAD} benchmark. At the same time, model-induced DSLs recover only part of this gain, remaining inconsistent across runs and short of their human-curated counterpart. Overall, the right representation closes much of the gap caused by high abstraction --- but inducing that layer of representation automatically is where models still fall short, and where we see a strong opportunity for the community to make progress.

</details>


### [249] [Beyond a Single Sentiment Score: Topical and Affective Dimensions of Emoji Meaning on Twitter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28337)
*Rohan James,Ioannis Christofilogiannis,Yuuv Jauhari,Shreya Shah,Gauri Pethkar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文指出“单一情感分数即表情符号意义”的观点不完整，提出主题凝聚度与情感离散度是表情符号意义的两个不同维度，并用推特语料与情感词典/情绪评分验证二者正相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流做法将 emoji 视为压缩情感标记，用一个情感分数概括其含义，作者认为这一图景不完整，需区分主题使用的凝聚程度与情感分布的离散程度。

Method: 构建 16,575 条英文推文语料；提出 per-emoji 指标 stability delta（句嵌入的类内减类间余弦相似度）衡量主题凝聚度；与 Kralj Novak 等(2015)情感词典及 Ferré 等(2025)西班牙语 13 情绪评分做相关分析；采用置换检验、BCa bootstrap、leave-one-out jackknife、控制 emoji 频率的偏相关、四检验族 Holm 校正；下游用无泄漏五折交叉验证在 Emoji Sarcasm Dataset 上做讽刺分类，对比门控多模态架构、微调 BERTweet、微调 RoBERTa。

Result: 主题高度聚类的 emoji 反而呈现更极化的众包情感：与 Kralj Novak 词典 Spearman ρ=+0.361（Holm p=0.015，95% bootstrap CI [+0.10,+0.59]）；与 Ferré 等西班牙语 13 情绪评分 ρ=+0.509（p=0.0003）；结论在多种稳健性检验下成立。下游三个基线 macro F1 均>0.97，表明数据集存在饱和的 emoji 标签线索。

Conclusion: 主题凝聚度与情感离散度是 emoji 意义中相互独立的维度，不能用单一情感分数概括；下游分类器仅作辅助证据，而非论文贡献。

Abstract: Emoji are widely treated as compact affective tokens whose meaning is summarised by a single sentiment score. We argue that this picture is incomplete. From a corpus of 16{,}575 English tweets and a per-emoji metric we call \emph{stability delta} (within-class minus between-class cosine similarity of sentence embeddings), we show that emojis used in tightly clustered topical contexts also exhibit \emph{more} polarised crowd-sourced sentiment, not less. Validated against the Kralj Novak et al.\ (2015) sentiment lexicon, the central correlation is Spearman $ρ= +0.361$ (Holm $p = 0.015$, 95\% bootstrap CI $[+0.10, +0.59]$); against the independent Ferré et al.\ (2025) Spanish 13-emotion ratings, $ρ= +0.509$ ($p = 0.0003$). The result survives permutation testing, BCa bootstrap, leave-one-out jackknife, partial correlation controlling for emoji frequency, and Holm correction across a four-test family. Topical coherence and affective dispersion are distinct dimensions of emoji meaning. As a downstream check we report leakage-free five-fold cross-validation results for sarcasm classification on the Emoji Sarcasm Dataset; all three baselines (a gated multimodal architecture, fine-tuned BERTweet features, and fine-tuned RoBERTa features) score above 0.97 macro F1, indicating the dataset has saturating emoji-label cues. We frame the classifier as supporting evidence rather than the contribution.

</details>


### [250] [DeclineCraft: A RAG Abstention Benchmark for Jointly Measuring Combined Retrieval and Parametric Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28340)
*Atharva Thakur,Abulhair Saparov,Bruno Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 DeclineCraft 动态弃答基准（基于语料截断后 Minecraft 新特性），在 27 个 LLM 上测 Correct Abstention Rate 等指标，发现单轮检索提升弃答率、迭代 RAG 与混合检索反而降低弃答率，且模型规模与发布日期均与 CAR 无显著关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠的检索增强生成（RAG）需识别检索文档与参数化知识均不支持回答的情形，但现有基准缺乏可控的“不可答”问题与对参数化暴露的审计；同时需考察模型规模、发布时间、思考模式与检索策略对弃答行为的影响。

Method: 构建 DeclineCraft 动态弃答基准：不可答问题针对语料截断后新增的 Minecraft 特性，并审计可能的参数化知识暴露，较晚截断点支持未来模型评测。在 27 个 LLM 上测量 Correct Abstention Rate（CAR）、Answerable Attempt Rate 与 Answer Accuracy，对比无检索、单轮检索、迭代 RAG（自我评估上下文并可最多两轮追加检索）、查询改写+重排序的混合（稠密+稀疏）检索，以及开启思考模式的影响。

Result: (1) 相较无检索，单轮检索在 40 个配置中的 38 个显著提高 CAR。(2) 迭代 RAG 相较单轮检索在 30/40 配置显著降低 CAR（均值 46.4%），Answer Accuracy 几乎不变（68.5%→69.3%）；在混合检索中加入查询改写与重排序使全部 12 个模型的 CAR 下降。(3) 更大模型答案更准确（与总参数量的 Spearman ρ=+0.60），但模型规模与发布日期均与 CAR 无显著关联。(4) 无检索时，对同一权重开启思考使 13 个模型中 8 个的 CAR 显著下降（平均 14 个百分点），回答从承认不确定性转向否认前提。

Conclusion: 更强的检索与推理能力并未带来更可靠的弃答：迭代检索、查询改写与重排序、思考模式均降低 CAR，而 CAR 与模型规模、发布日期无关。因此弃答能力需作为独立目标被显式评估与优化，DeclineCraft 提供了可随模型迭代复用的动态测试手段。

Abstract: Reliable retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires recognizing when neither retrieved documents nor parametric knowledge supports an answer. We introduce DeclineCraft, a dynamic abstention benchmark whose unanswerable questions target Minecraft feature additions after a corpus cut-off, with audits of possible parametric exposure. Later cut-offs support evaluation of future models. Across 27 LLMs, we measure Correct Abstention Rate (CAR; how often models acknowledge insufficient knowledge on unanswerable questions), Answerable Attempt Rate and Answer Accuracy. We find that (1) single-shot retrieval significantly raises CAR in 38 of 40 configurations (model and thinking setting) versus no retrieval. (2) Iterative RAG, in which the model self-assesses its context and can request up to two further retrieval rounds, significantly lowers CAR versus single-shot RAG in 30 of 40 configurations (mean 46.4%), with little change in Answer Accuracy (68.5% to 69.3%). Adding query rewriting and reranking to hybrid (dense & sparse) retrieval lowers CAR for all 12 models tested. (3) Larger models answer more accurately (Spearman $ρ= +0.60$ with total parameters), but neither model size nor release date shows a significant association with CAR. (4) Without retrieval, enabling thinking on the same weights lowers CAR significantly for 8 of 13 models (by 14% points on average), and the responses shift from acknowledged uncertainty to premise denial.

</details>


### [251] [Object-Oriented Harness: Evolving Agent Harnesses through Object-Oriented Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28380)
*Gaotang Li,Bhavana Dalvi Mishra,Yifei Ming,Yanfei Chen,Zhongying CuiZhu,Lesly Miculicich,Long T. Le,Rui Meng,Chun-Liang Li,Hanghang Tong,Chen-Yu Lee,Tomas Pfister*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出面向对象式Agent Harness框架OO-Harness，通过进化出可执行harness类层级并在测试时路由选择专用harness，在三个长程基准上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一全局harness难以应对需要不同执行策略的异构任务，需为不同任务类型提供专门化的执行策略。

Method: 采用面向对象设计进化harness类层级：训练时演化智能体依据执行记录生成一族专用harness，每个为基类或已有专用harness的子类（继承实现）；测试时用harness路由器依据训练中积累的路由经验为每个任务选择特定harness。

Result: 在覆盖业务流程、工作区任务与工具使用的三个长程基准上，OO-Harness在对比方法中性能最优，较基线最高绝对提升15%；消融实验验证了各核心组件的贡献。

Conclusion: 以类继承方式组织harness谱系并结合学习式路由，可有效应对异构长程任务的策略多样性，优于单一全局harness方案。

Abstract: Agent harnesses are executable code that specifies the prompts, tools, and control flow around a language model. A single global harness can struggle with heterogeneous tasks that require different execution strategies. In this work, we introduce Object-Oriented Harness (OO-Harness), a harness optimization framework that evolves a hierarchy of executable harness classes using object-oriented design. During training, an evolution agent uses execution records to create a family of specialized harnesses, each implemented as a subclass of the base or an existing specialized harness via inheritance. At test time, a harness router uses routing lessons accumulated during training to select a specific harness for each task. Across three long-horizon benchmarks spanning business workflows, workspace tasks, and tool use, OO-Harness achieves the best performance among the compared methods, with an absolute improvement of up to 15% over the base. Extensive ablation studies examine the contributions of its core components.

</details>


### [252] [When Copying Is Hard: Copy-Constrained Decoding for Exact Span Reproduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28393)
*Jinghui Zhang,Lang Gao,Zongfang Liu,Ruihong Zeng,Zirui Song,Rui Yan,Kentaro Inui,Xiuying Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建跨领域"精确跨度复现"基准，并提出无需微调的轻量插件 CopyGen，将复制分解为"何时复制、复制多远、何时停止"三决策，通过解码期 logits 调控实现受控复制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 即使上下文中存在目标字符串，逐字复用时常出现漂移或无法正确终止，暴露源接地与边界控制能力不足；该能力在代码生成中嵌入 API key 等敏感字符串等场景有实用价值，且并非模型可免费获得。

Method: 构建覆盖合同、科学文献、代码、随机序列的精确跨度复现基准；提出 CopyGen：冻结 LLM 上的轻量复制约束插件。先判定是否进入复制模式，再预测试探性复制长度，最后逐 token 校验生成跨度，自适应调整续写 token 的 logits 以激励或抑制续写，仅输出最长合法前缀。

Result: 在三种 LLM 主干、四项基准任务上，无需微调即相对提升平均精确匹配 35%；与 SFT 结合可在此基础上再提升 4%，同时显著加速生成。

Conclusion: 可靠的精确复制不是 LLM 自然具备的能力，而是需要显式建模的解码期控制问题；CopyGen 提供了有效的轻量解决路径。

Abstract: Precisely reproducing a target span verbatim within a long context is a fundamental capability test for LLMs: even when the target string is present in context, models often still drift within the span or fail to stop correctly, revealing limitations in source grounding and boundary control. This capability has broad practical relevance. For instance, code generation often requires embedding sensitive strings such as API keys exactly as they appear in context. In this work, we construct a benchmark to test exact span reproduction ability across contracts, scientific literature, code, and random sequences, and find that current models still make surprisingly frequent errors. To address this, we propose CopyGen, a lightweight copy-constrained plugin for frozen LLMs that turns copying from a byproduct of next-token prediction into a controlled process. Our key idea is to decompose copying into three distinct decisions: when to copy, how far to copy, and when to stop. Concretely, CopyGen first determines whether to enter copy mode, then predicts a tentative copy length, and finally verifies the generated span token by token. During verification, we adaptively adjust the logits of copy continuation tokens to incentivize or suppress continuation, and emit only the longest valid prefix. Across three LLM backbones and four benchmark tasks, CopyGen improves average exact match by 35% relative without model finetuning, and integrates seamlessly with SFT to further improve it by 4%, while substantially accelerating generation. These results suggest that reliable exact copying is not something LLMs obtain for free, but a decoding-time control problem that requires explicit modeling. Code is available at https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/CopyGen.

</details>


### [253] [The Instruction Tax on Factual Recall: Base Models Can Beat Their Instruction-Tuned Counterparts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28407)
*Christophe Khalil,Aya Mourad*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出AKBC LM-KBC 2026共享任务方案，得分0.6836，超基线一倍以上，核心发现是"指令税"效应：基座模型用文本补全提示优于指令微调模型的聊天接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务要求用≤32B参数语言模型在无检索、无微调条件下为subject-relation对生成所有可能object，作者旨在探索提示方法对事实回忆的影响。

Method: 用训练样本示例对基座模型进行文本补全提示，采样生成64–256个输出并仅保留重复出现的答案；针对各关系额外应用两种专门方法：一个提升大答案集召回率，另一个先验证人物是否在世再预测死亡地点。

Result: 排行榜得分0.6836（基线0.2964）；指令微调模型聊天接口仅得0.5681，基座模型文本补全达0.6836。

Conclusion: 提示方法学与模型架构同等重要；指令微调会降低事实召回（"指令税"），且该效应源于模型权重而非提示方式。

Abstract: We present our solution to the AKBC LM-KBC 2026 Shared Task, where we achieved a score of 0.6836 on the official leaderboard, more than double the baseline of 0.2964. This task requires generating all possible objects for subject-relation pairs using a language model with up to 32 billion parameters, with no retrieval or fine-tuning involved. We show that the prompting methodology is as important as the model architecture: while the instruction-tuned model version achieves 0.5681 with its chat interface, the base model achieves 0.6836 when prompted using text completion. Thus, instruction tuning decreases factual recall; we refer to this effect as the instruction tax, which is caused by the model's weights rather than the prompting method. Our final solution is fairly straightforward: we prompt the base model with some examples from the training data, generate 64--256 outputs, and retain only the repeated ones. Two specialized methods are then applied for each relation: one improves the recall of large answer sets, and the other verifies a person's vitality before predicting their place of death.

</details>


### [254] [Every Model Leaves a Trace: Multi-Resolution LLM Fingerprinting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28434)
*Mohammad Reza Modarres,Armin Tourajmehr,Artin Tavasoli,Yadollah Yaghoobzadeh,Mohammad Taher Pilehvar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究 LLM 生成文本的"指纹分辨率"问题：从模型分辨率（不同家族→蒸馏与微调变体）和信号分辨率（行为、风格、词汇、语义证据）两个维度，考察指纹能多细地区分相关模型，以及在表层线索被削减后哪些信号仍有信息量。结果表明指纹可超越家族差异，在蒸馏模型乃至同基座 LoRA 适配模型上仍可检测；表层与词汇线索被改写后归因减弱但仍有可观信号；语义表征跨语言最稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 会在生成文本中留下模型特有痕迹，但尚不清楚这些指纹能多精细地分辨"相关模型"，以及在明显线索被削弱时哪些信号仍然有效。论文由此提出系统研究指纹的分辨能力边界与稳健性。

Method: 提出"指纹分辨率"框架，分模型分辨率与信号分辨率两维：模型端从不同家族到蒸馏模型、LoRA 适配变体；信号端覆盖行为、风格计量（stylometric）、词汇、语义四类证据。实验上逐步抑制表层线索、对输出做改写（paraphrase）、改变可用文本量，并测试跨提示分布与跨语言的泛化性。

Result: 指纹在超越宽泛家族差异后仍持续存在，在蒸馏模型乃至同一基座的 LoRA 适配模型上仍可检测；表层与词汇线索被改动后归因性能下降，但仍有显著的模型特异信号残留；这些信号可跨提示来源与语言迁移，其中语义表征在不同语言间最为稳健。

Conclusion: 模型身份可在多个分辨率上被恢复，但可恢复性取决于模型相似度与文本中可用的证据。指纹归因的可靠性是分层的：细粒度区分更依赖语义级信号，而表层线索的作用有限。

Abstract: Large language models leave model-specific traces in their generated text, but it remains unclear how finely these fingerprints can distinguish related models and which signals remain informative as obvious cues are reduced. We study this through fingerprint resolution, considering both model resolution, from different families to distilled and adapted variants, and signal resolution across behavioral, stylometric, lexical, and semantic evidence. We progressively suppress surface cues, paraphrase outputs, vary the amount of available text, and test generalization across prompt distributions and languages. Our results show that fingerprints persist beyond broad family differences, remaining detectable in distilled models and even LoRA adaptations of the same base model. Although attribution weakens as surface and lexical cues are altered, substantial model-specific signal remains. These signals transfer across prompt sources and languages, with semantic representations proving most robust across languages. These findings show that model identity is recoverable at multiple resolutions, but that recoverability depends on model similarity and the evidence available in the text.

</details>


### [255] [MythoSemantic: An Interactive System for Discovering Semantic Parallels Across Mythological and Religious Traditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28452)
*Nikita Ganziuk,Innokentiy S. Humonen,Ilya Makarov,Pavel Lebedev*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出神话文本比较研究工具，用神经语言模型将文本嵌入共享语义空间，实现跨文化传统的语义平行检索，并量化词汇重叠与专有名词对嵌入几何的解释程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神话与宗教文本的比较研究高度依赖人工，劳动密集且难以规模化，缺乏可交互、可扩展的语义平行发现手段。

Method: 以神经语言模型将文本片段嵌入统一语义空间；在交互界面中检索跨文化语义平行；对嵌入片段的粗粒度几何结构与既有历史关系进行对齐分析；并通过消融/回归量化词汇重叠及专有名词对该几何结构的解释贡献。

Result: 嵌入片段形成可区分的语义结构，其粗粒度几何与文献记载的传统间历史关系相吻合；同时定量给出该几何中由词汇重叠和专有名词所解释的比例。系统以在线平台与可安装包形式发布。

Conclusion: 基于神经嵌入的交互式工具可支撑可扩展的神话与宗教文本比较研究，且嵌入空间结构在一定程度上反映真实历史关联，但需剥离表层词汇与专名信号方能评估其语义价值。

Abstract: We present a tool for the comparative study of mythological and religious texts. Traditional manual analysis is highly labor-intensive and difficult to scale. To address this, we use neural language models to embed texts into a shared semantic space, so that users can find semantic parallels across cultural traditions in an interactive interface. Embedded fragments form distinct semantic structures whose coarse geometry aligns with well-documented historical relations between traditions. We quantify how much of that geometry is already explained by lexical overlap and by proper names. The current system is available at https://mythoscope.io, and the installable package is available at https://github.com/haafus/MythoSemantic/blob/main/RUN.md.

</details>


### [256] [Asymmetric Looped Transformers: Fixed Global Representations for an Iterative Decoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28489)
*Cheng Liang,Tengfei Zhang,Wenjie DU,Jianyu Wu,Changlian Ma,Shuchen Pu,Ya Zhang,Yanfeng Wang,Zhouhan Lin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出非对称循环Transformer（AsymLoop），将单次上下文编码与循环状态精炼解耦，在相同有效深度下优于全栈循环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环Transformer通过重复应用共享层提升有效深度，但全栈循环把上下文构建与迭代状态精炼混在同一循环计算中，二者角色未被显式区分。

Method: 单次前向的因果编码器产生层特定的全局KV缓存并在各迭代间固定；权重绑定的循环解码器由演化状态生成Local KV；在单一softmax下对两类KV做联合注意力。训练时对编解码器采用重尾引导的逐层学习率方法。

Result: 在FineWeb-Edu上，60M至1B四个规模、匹配有效深度与训练token预算条件下，验证困惑度一致更低、下游平均准确率更高；1B模型在七个常识推理零样本基准上平均准确率由49.58%升至50.85%。收益可延伸至更长训练预算、OLMo风格骨干与稀疏MoE模型。

Conclusion: 非对称上下文编码与状态精炼是循环语言模型的有效设计范式。

Abstract: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying shared layers, offering a way to scale computation without increasing parameter count. However, full-stack looping places context construction and iterative state refinement within the same recurrent computation, without explicitly distinguishing their roles. We introduce the Asymmetric Looped Transformer (AsymLoop), which separates single-pass context encoding from recurrent state refinement. A single-pass causal encoder produces layer-specific Global key-value (KV) caches that remain fixed across iterations, while a weight-tied recurrent decoder generates Local KV from its evolving state. Joint attention over both sources under a single softmax allows each update to integrate persistent contextual information with the current intermediate state. For training, we apply a heavy-tail-guided layerwise learning-rate method to the encoder and decoder. Experiments on FineWeb-Edu across four model scales, from 60M to 1B, show consistently lower validation perplexity and higher average downstream accuracy than Full Loop under matched effective depth and training token budgets. At 1B, AsymLoop improves average zero-shot accuracy across seven commonsense reasoning benchmarks from 49.58% to 50.85%. Further experiments extend these benefits to longer training budgets, an OLMo-style backbone, and sparse mixture-of-experts models. These results support asymmetric context encoding and state refinement as an effective design for recurrent language models.

</details>


### [257] [OptionWorld: A Benchmark for Diagnosing Failures of LLMs as Long-Term Personal Assistants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28491)
*Ruoyu Zhang,Zhaocen Liu,Weiyi Tian,Melissa Feng,Shilong Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 OptionWorld 基准，追踪模拟日常任务中信息获取、判断、行动与结果，定位 LLM 作为长期个人助理的三类失败：事实未获取/整合、行动机会未利用、施加任务未要求的限制；并通过三项补充实验验证这些失败的因果性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期助理需跨天跟踪未完成任务，而"找到信息"或"开始行动"并不保证任务完成，现有评测缺乏对任务状态维持过程的细粒度诊断。

Method: 构建 OptionWorld 模拟日常任务基准，记录决策输入、信息获取、判断、行动与最终结果，对失败实例进行归因分析（含截止前最后输入中关键事实仍存在的比例统计），并设计三项干预实验：补充缺失事实、行动提醒、纠正错误限制性备注。

Result: 35.5% 的失败实例中，关键事实在截止前的最后一次模型输入中仍然存在；最常见三类失败为信息未获取或未整合、可用行动机会未使用、代理自行施加非必要限制；补充缺失事实可部分恢复成功，行动提醒能重启工作但后续步骤仍超期，纠正误禁联系的备注可恢复允许的询问行为。

Conclusion: 当前 LLM 的核心短板在于任务状态维持：将事实与未完成工作关联、在截止前贯彻执行、区分真实约束与代理自身假设。

Abstract: Long-term assistants must follow unfinished tasks across days as information and circumstances change. Finding information or starting an action, however, does not ensure that the task gets completed. We introduce OptionWorld, a benchmark that traces information acquisition, judgments, actions, and outcomes in simulated daily-life tasks to identify where current LLMs fall short as long-term personal assistants. In runs with archived decision inputs, the key facts remain in the model's last input before the deadline in 35.5% of failed instances. Failure analysis identifies the three most frequent problems: needed information is not obtained or combined, available opportunities to act go unused, and agents impose restrictions that the task does not require. Three follow-up experiments show that supplying missing facts restores task success in some cases; action reminders can restart work while subsequent steps still miss the deadline; and correcting a supplied note that wrongly forbids contact restores permitted inquiry. These findings locate shortcomings in maintaining task state: connecting facts to unfinished work, following through before deadlines, and separating actual restrictions from the agent's assumptions.

</details>


### [258] [BitMTP: When Multi-Token Prediction Meets Low-Bit Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28500)
*Ning Zhang,Shihao Wang,Jinrui Zhang,Chaodong Xiao,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: BitMTP 是一个面向超低比特 LLM 骨架的算法-系统协同设计框架，通过联合 NTP/MTP 目标与"已接受前缀对齐"执行契约，实现单模型内的高质量投机式多 token 解码，在 H20 上取得 2.1–2.4 倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超低比特骨架与多 token 预测（MTP）在原理上互补：前者降低权重存储、访存与线性层开销，后者减少串行解码步数。但两者直接组合无法在可比质量下加速解码——掩码式起草缺少下一 token 训练中提供的中间 token 输入；更宽的计算与因果 KV 更新又会抵消减少步数带来的收益。

Method: 1) 联合 NTP 与 MTP 训练目标，使单一模型同时具备自回归生成与块因果（block-causal）起草能力；2) 提供仅置信度解码、纯投机解码与混合解码三种模式，在无独立草稿/验证模型的前提下给出不同质量-吞吐权衡点；3) 提出"已接受前缀对齐"机制，保持已提交前缀、实体化因果 KV 边界与 CUDA Graph 重放状态三者一致以支持连续生成；4) 基于该契约选择宽度特化的低比特执行策略，并在共享 KV 存储上复用已捕获的计算图。

Result: NVIDIA H20 上，混合解码在五任务均值上相对基线取得 2.2 倍加速（BitNet b1.58-2B）与 2.1–2.4 倍加速（1.7B–4B Bonsai 模型），任务质量相当；RTX 3090 上五任务均值吞吐最高 2.0 倍，Jetson Orin 上 MBPP+ 最高 3.3 倍。

Conclusion: 结果表明 BitMTP 可跨不同骨架、模型规模与 GPU 类型加速超低比特 LLM 生成；核心贡献在于以训练目标设计与执行契约（前缀/KV/图重放一致性）打通算法与系统层，避免额外草稿模型与冗余计算。源码已开源。

Abstract: For efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs), methods of ultra-low-bit backbones reduce weight storage, memory traffic, and linear-layer execution cost, while multi-token prediction (MTP) methods reduce sequential decoding steps by predicting multiple future tokens in parallel. Although complementary, the direct combination of these methods cannot accelerate decoding at comparable quality: masked drafting lacks intermediate token input supplied in next-token training, while wider computation and causal key-value (KV) updates can offset the savings from fewer steps. To address these challenges, we propose BitMTP, an algorithm-system co-design framework for efficient MTP on ultra-low-bit LLM backbones. A joint next-token prediction and MTP objective equips a single model with both autoregressive (AR) generation and block-causal drafting. Confidence-only decoding, speculative-only decoding, and hybrid decoding provide different quality-throughput operating points without using separate draft and verifier models. Accepted-prefix alignment keeps the committed prefix, materialized causal KV boundary, and CUDA Graph replay state consistent for continued generation. BitMTP uses this contract to select width-specialized low-bit execution and reuse captured graphs over shared KV storage. On NVIDIA H20, BitMTP with hybrid decoding achieves five-task mean speedups of 2.2x on BitNet b1.58-2B and 2.1-2.4x on 1.7B-4B Bonsai models at comparable task quality. On RTX 3090 and Jetson Orin, it further achieves up to 2.0x in five-task mean throughput and 3.3x on MBPP+, respectively. These results demonstrate that BitMTP accelerates ultra-low-bit LLM generation across backbones, model sizes, and GPU types. The source code is released at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/BitMTP

</details>


### [259] [Large Flow Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28559)
*Arnav Chavan,Chanhyuk Lee,Udbhav Bamba,Jaehoon Yoo,Seunghoon Hong,Aditi Raghunathan,Jinwoo Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Lafa（8B参数的分块连续流语言模型），通过适配预训练AR模型高效训练，并利用流训练的多token预测效应实现自推测解码，吞吐达AR的2.54倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续流（flow）语言模型支持并行生成及离散扩散不具备的控制与加速工具，但十亿参数级别的有效构建方法尚不成熟；作者希望验证连续流能否作为可扩展的语言建模基础。

Method: Lafa采用分块流结构：前缀使用因果注意力，块内为双向异步流；通过改造预训练自回归（AR）模型实现数据高效训练；推理时用前缀缓存与块并行解码加速；用少于30B token训练0.5B、7B、8B三个规模；可将流蒸馏为flow map实现一步/少步生成；并设计单模型内的自推测解码——用AR方式验证流式草稿。

Result: 在指令遵循、推理、编程任务上，学习到的流质量匹配或超越AR；训练token效率优于以往扩散模型；流训练通过多token预测效应保持甚至提升预训练AR能力；自推测解码在同质量下吞吐为AR的2.54倍，优于多token预测与离散扩散方法。

Conclusion: 连续流可作为语言建模的可扩展基础，兼具训练效率、可控性与推理加速能力。

Abstract: Continuous flow language models offer a path to parallel generation with tools for control and acceleration unavailable to discrete diffusion, yet effective techniques for building them at the billion-parameter scale remain less established. We present Lafa (Large flow language model), a fast, high-performing flow language model scaled to 8B parameters in a data-efficient manner. Lafa is a blockwise flow model with causal attention on the prefix and bidirectional, asynchronous flow within each block. This design enables efficient training by adapting pretrained autoregressive (AR) models and fast inference via prefix caching and blockwise parallel decoding. We train Lafa at 0.5B, 7B, and 8B scales with fewer than 30B tokens, more efficient than previous diffusion models, and evaluate it on instruction following, reasoning, and coding, where the learned flow matches or surpasses the quality of AR and can be distilled into flow maps for one- and few-step generation. Notably, flow training preserves or even improves pretrained AR capabilities via a multi-token prediction effect, which we leverage in a self-speculative decoding scheme that verifies flow-based drafts autoregressively within a single model. This yields 2.54x the throughput of an AR model at comparable quality, outperforming multi-token prediction and discrete diffusion methods. Our findings show that continuous flows can serve as a scalable foundation for language modeling.

</details>


### [260] [Cache Engineering for Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28577)
*Tianyu Fu,Ruoxi Wang,Zihan Min,Zhongqi Ren,Zhihao Li,Tengxuan Liu,Shengxu Mu,Hanling Zhang,Yu Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"cache engineering"新方案，让LLM智能体直接通过drop与repos两类缓存操作控制活跃KV cache，无需修改轨迹或重新prefill，并协同设计AKV服务引擎处理历史依赖性，实现吞吐与延迟优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体轨迹变长，KV cache的I/O与存储成为主要开销；轨迹可能超出最大上下文长度，需控制活跃缓存增长。既有context engineering通过裁剪或摘要压缩缓存，但修改轨迹前缀会使后续缓存状态失效，触发保留上下文昂贵的重新prefill，且保留过少上下文会损害任务精度。

Method: 提出cache engineering方案：智能体可主动用drop将选定缓存从未来注意力中排除，用repos调整保留key的位置编码，从而在不修改轨迹、不重新prefill的前提下控制活跃KV cache。形式化定义这些缓存操作，并识别"历史依赖性"服务挑战（相同token序列在不同缓存操作序列下产生不同缓存状态，使前缀匹配不足以正确复用）。据此协同设计AKV服务引擎，对外提供与现有serving API兼容的无状态接口，内部管理有状态缓存复用、驱逐与恢复。

Result: 工具响应滚动drop缓存策略相比传统阈值触发摘要，平均基准分数提升1.7分、平均成本降低27.7%；AKV实现最高1.2倍输出吞吐与P95请求延迟1.5倍加速；缓存策略的递归自我改进在专家设计基础上进一步降本7.1%。

Conclusion: cache engineering可有效降低长轨迹智能体的KV cache开销并保持任务精度，配合AKV引擎解决历史依赖下的正确缓存复用问题，且策略可由模型递归自优化。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost. Trajectories can also exceed the LLM's maximum context length, requiring control over active cache growth. Prior work uses context engineering to reduce cache size by trimming or summarizing history. However, modifying the trajectory prefix invalidates subsequent cached states and triggers costly re-prefilling of retained context. Task accuracy can also suffer when too little context is retained to limit re-prefill costs. We propose cache engineering as a new scheme. It allows agents to directly control their active KV cache without modifying the trajectory or re-prefilling retained context. Specifically, agents can proactively use drop to exclude selected cache from future attention and repos to adjust retained keys' position encodings. We formalize these cache operations and identify history dependence as a serving challenge: identical token sequences can yield different cache states under different cache operation sequences, making prefix matching insufficient for correct cache reuse. Thus, we co-design the AKV serving engine. It provides a stateless interface compatible with existing serving APIs, while internally managing stateful cache reuse, eviction, and restoration. Experiments show that a tool-response rolling-drop cache policy improves average benchmark scores by 1.7 points and reduces average cost by 27.7%, compared with conventional threshold-triggered summarization. With AKV, it achieves up to 1.2x the output throughput and a 1.5x speedup in P95 request latency. Recursive self-improvement of cache policies further reduces cost by 7.1% over expert design. Our code is at https://github.com/thu-nics/AKV.

</details>


### [261] [Capable Teacher, Myopic Scorer: Reward-Free Teacher Repair for Agentic On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28586)
*Shu Zhao,Tan Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文指出agentic on-policy distillation的核心问题并非简单的compounding error，而是"rollout-scorer gap"：teacher执行的takeover能完成任务，但其next-token打分却放行拖延型动作。作者提出R2S，在蒸馏前先用高分歧状态上的teacher takeover修复scorer，再冻结该teacher作为标准OPD的唯一打分器，在12个teacher-student-environment组合上全面超越三种SOTA方法，平均提升12.8个success point。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有agentic OPD的失败常被归因于compounding error，即学生错误使轨迹偏离teacher可靠区域，因此近期方法（episode-length curriculum、teacher-guided turns、prefix replay、分歧处teacher干预）都试图把训练限制在teacher可靠区域内。但作者发现该解释不完整：在student与teacher分歧最大的状态上，teacher自身的takeover仍能完成任务，而用其token score训练出的student却反复耗尽回合。根源在于next-token scoring的短视性——teacher逐token打分时看不到episode终点，因而放行了outcome-based RL会以零奖励惩罚的安全但拖延的动作，而agentic OPD恰好缺少这一惩罚。

Method: R2S（Rollout-to-Scorer Distillation）在蒸馏前先修复scorer：(1) 从未训练student中挖掘高分歧状态；(2) 从这些状态运行teacher takeover；(3) 保留足够多takeover通过reward-free检验（如consensus或LLM judge）的状态；(4) 微调teacher，使其在从分歧turn起的所有assistant token上给出takeover-informed的分数，且上下文中不含takeover本身。修复后的teacher被冻结，作为标准OPD的唯一scorer；修复与训练全过程均不需要task reward。

Result: 在三个环境、两个teacher、四个student共12个teacher-student-environment组合中，R2S全部优于三种SOTA agentic-OPD方法，相对各组合中最优基线平均提升12.8个success point。

Conclusion: agentic OPD的瓶颈不只是compounding error，更在于teacher"做的"与"打分的"之间的rollout-scorer gap。通过把teacher takeover所体现的outcome-aware判断回灌到token-level scorer，可在无需任务奖励的条件下显著提升蒸馏效果，说明修复scorer应先于修复轨迹分布。

Abstract: Agentic on-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student agent on its own trajectories while a teacher scores every token. A natural explanation of where it goes wrong is compounding error: the student's mistakes carry its trajectories beyond the region where the teacher is reliable, so recent methods keep training inside that region, through episode-length curricula, teacher-guided turns, prefix replay, or teacher intervention where the two disagree. We show this explanation is incomplete. From the states where the student departs most from the teacher, the teacher's own takeovers still finish the task, yet the student trained on its token scores keeps running out of turns. We attribute this to the myopia of next-token scoring. The teacher rates each token without seeing where the episode ends, so its scores let through the safe, delaying moves that outcome-based RL would punish with zero reward, a penalty agentic OPD lacks. We call this difference between what the teacher does and what it scores the rollout-scorer gap. We propose Rollout-to-Scorer Distillation (R2S), which repairs the scorer before distillation by mining high-disagreement states from the untrained student, running teacher takeovers from them, keeping the states where enough takeovers pass a reward-free check such as consensus or an LLM judge, and fine-tuning the teacher to give its takeover-informed scores on every assistant token from the divergence turn onward, without the takeover in context. The repaired teacher is frozen as the sole scorer for standard OPD, requiring no task reward during repair or training. Across three environments, two teachers and four students, R2S outperforms three state-of-the-art agentic-OPD methods in all twelve teacher-student-environment cells, by 12.8 success points on average over the best of them in each cell. Project page: https://tree-shu-zhao.github.io/r2s/.

</details>


### [262] [Benchmarking Arabic Dialects for Math Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28607)
*Noor Abo Mokh,Teresa Lynn,Nizar Habash,Ahmed Elshabrawy,Sara Alhajeri,Alaa Elsetohy,Preslav Nakov,Alham Fikri Aji*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 DAR-MGSM，首个针对方言阿拉伯语数学推理的人工构建基准，包含五个主要方言与 MSA 的两版并行数学应用题（纯翻译版与文化本地化版），评估 11 个模型并做机制可解释性分析，发现文化本地化普遍降低性能且同一题目的两种版本诱发不同的内部推理轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 方言阿拉伯语等低资源语言的数学推理能力研究不足，缺乏可评估其语言变体与文化语境影响的基准数据。

Method: 构建 DAR-MGSM 基准：人工筛选需多步推理的数学应用题，覆盖五个阿拉伯方言与 MSA，提供"仅翻译"和"翻译+文化本地化"两个平行版本（后者替换实体与指代为区域化表达）；在 11 个阿拉伯语中心和多语言大模型上进行评测，并进行机制可解释性分析。

Result: 模型在本地化版本上性能总体下降，但下降幅度因模型而异，阿拉伯语中心模型对本地化的敏感度差异明显；机制分析显示，同一应用题的两个版本常产生不同的内部推理轨迹，即使总体准确率相近。

Conclusion: 数学推理表现同时受语言变体与文化语境影响，文化与方言因素不可被单纯翻译所替代，需在基准设计与模型评估中显式考虑。

Abstract: Mathematical reasoning remains underexplored for low-resource languages, including Dialectal Arabic. To bridge this gap, we introduce the DAR-MGSM (Dialectal Arabic Multilingual Grade School Math) Benchmark, the first manually curated benchmark for evaluating mathematical reasoning in Dialectal Arabic. DAR-MGSM consists of math word problems (MWPs) requiring multi-step reasoning and covers five major Arabic dialects alongside Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). The benchmark comprises two parallel versions: translated-only and translated & culturally localized. The latter version adapts entities and references to regional varieties. We evaluate eleven Arabic-centric and multilingual large language models on DAR-MGSM. The results show that the performance generally declines on the localized version, highlighting the challenges introduced by culturally grounded adaptations. However, the magnitude of this effect varies across models, with Arabic-centric models exhibiting different levels of sensitivity to localization. A mechanistic interpretability analysis shows that translated and localized variants of the same MWPs often induce distinct internal reasoning trajectories, even when aggregate accuracy remains similar. Overall, our results show that mathematical reasoning performance depends on both linguistic variety and cultural context.

</details>


### [263] [NarraSpace: Multimodal Scene-Grounded Evidence for Picture-Description Dementia Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28616)
*Qingming Li,Ruiyan Sun,Satoshi Nakamura*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: NarraSpace：将图片描述任务的词、语音时间对齐到具名画面元素与场景事件，构建可解释的叙事—空间特征并结合冻结语言模型评分，在ADReSS 48人测试集上取得81.25%准确率与91.32% AUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图片描述式痴呆分类共享同一视觉场景，但仅做转写文本级预测无法识别其输入所依据的场景证据，缺乏可核查性与可解释性。

Method: 将词语与语音时间链接到具名图片元素，并为预定义场景事件检索相关话语；构造叙事—空间描述符（覆盖度、时间组织）；用冻结语言模型在AD与健康对照训练样本示例下对每个事件的文本做对比打分，同时结合转写困惑度与覆盖度度量；保留源记录，使事件分数可回溯至源话语、语音区间与词汇匹配；最终使用固定SVM分类器。

Result: 在ADReSS官方48人测试集上，固定SVM在50个随机种子下平均准确率80.88%±2.56%；概率平均后准确率81.25%，ROC-AUC达91.32%。

Conclusion: NarraSpace使场景关联分类输入的构建过程显式且可审查，通过将事件索引的语言模型度量与源话语、语音时序及抽取记录相连，可为临床医生复核图片描述提供量化摘要与原始语音证据。

Abstract: Picture-description dementia classification uses a shared visual scene, but a transcript-level prediction alone does not identify the scene evidence underlying its inputs. NarraSpace links words and speech times to named picture elements and retrieves utterances for predefined scene events. Narrative-spatial descriptors summarize coverage and temporal organization. A frozen language model contrasts each event's text under examples from Alzheimer's disease and healthy-control training participants, alongside transcript surprisal and coverage measurements. Retained source records link event scores to their source utterances, speech intervals, and lexical matches. On the official 48-participant test set of the Alzheimer's Dementia Recognition through Spontaneous Speech benchmark, a fixed support vector classifier achieves $80.88\%\pm2.56\%$ mean accuracy over fifty seeds; averaged probabilities yield $81.25\%$ accuracy and $91.32\%$ area under the receiver operating characteristic curve. NarraSpace makes the construction of scene-linked classification inputs explicit and inspectable by connecting event-indexed language-model measurements to their source utterances, speech timing, and extraction records. Such source-linked measurements could support clinician review of picture descriptions by presenting quantitative summaries alongside the original speech evidence.

</details>


### [264] [OPLoRA: Orthogonal Projection LoRA Prevents Catastrophic Forgetting during Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.13003)
*Yifeng Xiong,Xiaohui Xie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出OPLoRA，用双侧正交投影把LoRA更新限制在前k奇异子空间的正交补中，从而在微调时精确保持预训练知识、显著缓解灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA可高效微调大模型，但其学到的更新会干扰承载预训练关键知识的主奇异方向，导致灾难性遗忘，缺乏对知识保留的机制性保障。

Method: 对冻结权重做SVD分解，构造投影P_L=I−U_kU_k^T与P_R=I−V_kV_k^T，将LoRA更新约束在前k奇异子空间的正交补内；并从理论上证明该构造精确保留前k个奇异三元组。同时引入度量ρ_k量化更新与主方向的子空间对齐/干扰程度。

Result: 在常识推理、数学与代码生成任务上，于LLaMA-2 7B与Qwen2.5 7B上实验，OPLoRA显著降低遗忘，同时任务性能保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 正交投影是参数高效微调中实现知识保留的有效机制，OPLoRA提供了理论保证与实证支持。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient fine-tuning of large language models but suffers from catastrophic forgetting when learned updates interfere with the dominant singular directions that encode essential pre-trained knowledge. We propose Orthogonal Projection LoRA (OPLoRA), a theoretically grounded approach that prevents this interference through double-sided orthogonal projections. By decomposing frozen weights via SVD, OPLoRA constrains LoRA updates to lie entirely within the orthogonal complement of the top-$k$ singular subspace using projections $P_L = I - U_k U_k^\top$ and $P_R = I - V_k V_k^\top$. We prove that this construction exactly preserves the top-$k$ singular triples, providing mathematical guarantees for knowledge retention. To quantify subspace interference, we introduce $ρ_k$, a metric measuring update alignment with dominant directions. Extensive experiments across commonsense reasoning, mathematics, and code generation demonstrate that OPLoRA significantly reduces forgetting while maintaining competitive task-specific performance on LLaMA-2 7B and Qwen2.5 7B, establishing orthogonal projection as an effective mechanism for knowledge preservation in parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [265] [3D-MoE: Complementarity-Guided Hardware-Software Co-Design for MoE Decode on 3D-Stacked NMP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26991)
*Yudong Pan,Lian Liu,Shixin Zhao,Yintao He,Kaiyan Chang,Tianhua Han,Chenyang Ai,Haonan Zhu,Mengdi Wang,Yinhe Han,Ying Wang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出 3D-MoE，一种面向 3D 堆叠近存处理（NMP）的 MoE 解码软硬件协同系统，利用"专家互补性"缓解专家并行中的局部性—负载均衡冲突。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE 解码高度受限于存储带宽，且专家负载严重偏斜、随解码步动态变化。3D 堆叠 DRAM 近存处理虽提供所需带宽，但其分块组织使负载均衡代价高昂：专家并行（EP）保局部性但受热点失衡困扰，更分布式的策略则削弱局部性并增加 NoC 流量，形成局部性与均衡性的冲突。

Method: 观察到领域特化路由使专家负载在各解码步间产生相互抵消的波动（专家互补性）。据此设计三层机制：(1) 离线一次性、互补性引导的分组与局部性感知映射，建立粗粒度组间均衡；(2) 轻量级协同存储—网络（CMN），将热点专家权重分块经重构的本地广播路径从宿主 DRAM 通道一次性流式送至辅助核心，处理组内残余热点；(3) 代价感知的在线重映射以应对负载漂移。

Result: 在多种 MoE 模型上，相比 EP 实现平均 4.63× 的 MoE 层加速；端到端吞吐较最强 NMP 基线提升 1.58×–1.86×，仅增加 2.11% 逻辑裸片面积。

Conclusion: 通过利用专家互补性并结合离线分组映射、组内广播式热点复制与在线重映射，3D-MoE 有效调和了 NMP 架构下 MoE 解码的局部性与负载均衡矛盾，以极小面积开销获得显著性能收益。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) have become a mainstream way to scale Large Language Models (LLMs), because each token activates only a small subset of experts, reducing inference cost. However, MoE decode remains highly memory-bound and exhibits strongly skewed, time-varying expert loads. 3D-stacked DRAM near-memory processing (NMP) provides the bandwidth that decode demands, yet its tiled organization makes load balancing expensive: expert parallelism (EP) preserves locality but suffers from hotspot-induced imbalance, while more distributed strategies weaken locality and increase NoC traffic.
  To address this locality-balance conflict, we observe that domain-specialized token routing creates offsetting expert-load fluctuations across decode steps, a property we call expert complementarity. Using this insight, we propose 3D-MoE, a hardware--software co-designed system for MoE decode on 3D-stacked NMP. 3D-MoE uses offline, one-time complementarity-guided grouping and locality-aware mapping to establish coarse-grained inter-group balance, handles residual intra-group hotspots through a lightweight Collaborative Memory-Network (CMN) that streams each hot expert's weight tiles once from its host DRAM channel to helper cores over a reconfigured local broadcast path, and uses cost-aware online remapping to remain robust to workload drift. Across MoE models, 3D-MoE achieves an average 4.63$\times$ MoE-layer speedup over EP and improves end-to-end throughput by 1.58$\times$--1.86$\times$ over the strongest NMP baselines, with 2.11\% additional logic-die area.

</details>


### [266] [Sustainable Processing-in-DRAM Integration and Replacement for Transformer Inference Servers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27345)
*Bipin Thapa Magar,Ishan Thakkar*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向存内计算（PID）推理服务器的碳建模框架，涵盖隐含碳及空闲/活跃运行碳，并评估3种GPU基线、6种PID架构与8类transformer负载，同时提出考虑老化的最优更换周期模型（10年跨度）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PID加速器被视为替代GPU进行transformer推理的可持续方案（近数据计算、缓解带宽瓶颈、降低能耗），但现有碳分析仅覆盖有限的硬件与工作负载，缺乏对隐含碳、空闲碳及老化的系统刻画。

Method: 构建PID推理服务器的碳建模框架，同时计入隐含碳与空闲/活跃运行碳；评测覆盖3种GPU基线、6种PID架构、8种transformer工作负载；并提出老化感知模型，在10年时间尺度上求碳最优更换周期；进一步分析GPU搭配选择与CDP指标。

Result: 引入PID使总隐含碳最多增加2.5%，总碳排放在encoder负载上最多降低1.14×、decoder负载上降低1.04×；在高端的HGX-H100服务器中引入PID模块，其总碳比A100和H100服务器高5.4–5.9×，源于更高的空闲碳与隐含碳；相对仅A100基线，在更高端GPU服务器中引入PID会使encoder负载的CDP上升、decoder负载的CDP下降。

Conclusion: PID的碳收益高度依赖于配套GPU选择与工作负载类型：隐含碳增量有限，但总碳节省幅度较小且可能被高端的空闲碳与隐含碳抵消，因此需结合老化与更换周期做全生命周期碳评估。

Abstract: Processing-in-DRAM (PID) accelerators are emerging as a sustainable alternative to GPUs for transformer model inference. They bring compute to data, mitigate the memory bandwidth limitation, and reduce the overall energy footprint. Yet, carbon analysis of PID accelerators is covered for only a limited set of hardware and workloads. In this work, we present a carbon modeling framework for PID-enabled inference servers that captures embodied carbon along with idle and active operational carbon. Our evaluation spans three GPU baselines, six PID architectures, and eight transformer workloads. Additionally, we propose an aging-aware model that finds the carbon-optimal replacement period for PID accelerators over a 10-year horizon. Across evaluated configurations, our analysis shows that including PIDs in AI inference servers increases the total embodied carbon by at most 2.5\%, while the total carbon is reduced by up to 1.14$\times$ for encoder and 1.04$\times$ for decoder transformer workloads. The results also depend on GPU selection for pairing, where introducing PID modules in high-end HGX-H100 servers incurs 5.4--5.9$\times$ higher total carbon compared to A100 and H100 servers, due to their larger idle and embodied carbon. Introducing PID modules in higher-end GPU servers, compared to the A100-only baseline, increases (decreases) the total carbon-delay product (CDP) for encoder workloads (decoder workloads).

</details>


### [267] [Stop Paying by the Letter: Accelerating Full-Chip RTL Simulation with Host-Side Tokenized Logging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27356)
*Daniel Keller,Rohit Kumar*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出一种宿主侧仿真内令牌化日志架构，用链接期ELF格式串虚拟地址作为令牌，结合固定32位字对齐槽协议，在Arm/RISC-V/DSP多核SoC上消除片上格式化与MMIO总线瓶颈，实现零仿真周期的位精确字符串重构，零固件调用点修改。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RTL仿真中固件printf诊断日志代价高昂（每次调用3.04–15.23 μs），且成本呈双区域分布：跨fabric路径受MMIO总线停顿主导（84.7%），本地子系统路径受片上vsprintf格式化主导（61.7%）。现有嵌入式令牌化方案面向flash占用与线上字节并依赖离线解码，无法满足UVM scoreboard所需的实时、零仿真时间字符串重建需求。

Method: 以链接期ELF格式串虚拟地址作为令牌，跨Arm、RISC-V、DSP核采用固定的32位字对齐槽协议；片上日志退化为单遍格式符扫描加(1+S)次MMIO字写入，彻底去除片上基数转换(C_fmt→0)；由SystemVerilog monitor在零仿真周期(Δt_sim=0)内重构位精确字符串，且无需修改固件调用点。

Result: 消除全部片上基数转换，减少85.0%–94.5%的实际总线事务、84.6%–93.3%的MMIO总线停顿周期、63.5%–90.9%的片上日志总周期（加速2.74×–11.03×）。858对匹配全芯片测试对、1,716配对运行（共1,972次运行）达到100%输出一致性，零仿真器内存开销；每轮回归节省1,314.85 CPU小时（-26.18%），测试CPU时间中位数下降41.51%（Suite A）与21.33%（Suite B），trace缩减42.84%、波形缩减28.82%。

Conclusion: 通过将格式化从片内迁移至宿主侧仿真监视器、并以MMIO写事务替代昂贵的片上处理，可在不修改固件的前提下同时消除MMIO停顿与格式化两大瓶颈，在保持逐位输出一致性的同时显著降低全芯片RTL验证的计算、存储与调试迹成本。

Abstract: Firmware diagnostic logging (printf) is an essential debug instrument in full-chip SoC design verification, yet it imposes a heavy tax on cycle-accurate RTL simulation: formatting a 30-character, 1-argument message on a simulated CPU and serializing it through an MMIO aperture costs 3.04 to 15.23 $μ$s per call (15.27 $μ$s unweighted / 15.08 $μ$s print-weighted critical-path mean on Suite A). Unlike embedded tokenizers that target flash footprint and wire bytes with offline decoding, RTL simulation is governed by a two-regime cost function---cross-fabric SoC paths are dominated by MMIO bus stalls (84.7% of call latency) whereas local subsystem paths are dominated by on-core vsprintf formatting (61.7%)---and requires live, zero-simulation-time string reconstruction to drive UVM scoreboards.
  We present a host-side in-simulation tokenized logging architecture for heterogeneous multi-core SoCs that eliminates both bottlenecks with zero firmware call-site edits. Using link-time ELF format-string virtual addresses as tokens over a fixed 32-bit word-aligned slot protocol across Arm, RISC-V, and DSP cores, on-core logging collapses to a single-pass specifier scan and $(1+S)$ MMIO word writes. This removes all on-core radix conversion ($C_{\mathrm{fmt}} \to 0$), 85.0%--94.5% of deployed bus transactions, 84.6%--93.3% of MMIO bus-stall cycles, and 63.5%--90.9% of total on-core logging cycles ($2.74\times$--$11.03\times$), while a SystemVerilog monitor reconstructs bit-exact strings in zero simulated cycles ($Δt_{\mathrm{sim}} = 0$). Across 858 matched full-chip test pairs (1,716 paired runs across 1,972 runs), we achieve 100% output parity with zero simulator memory overhead, saving 1,314.85 CPU hours (-26.18%) per regression pass, cutting median test CPU time by 41.51% (Suite A) and 21.33% (Suite B), and shrinking traces by 42.84% and waveforms by 28.82%.

</details>


### [268] [M3D-FLOW: A Monolithic 3-D-Stackable Processing-Near-DRAM Architecture for Generative Normalizing Flow Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27371)
*Bipin Thapa Magar,Ishan Thakkar,Sudeep Pasricha*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出 M3D-FLOW，一种基于单片三维堆叠 DRAM 的存内近处理（PNM）架构，用于加速 Normalizing Flows 生成模型，实现至少 6.6× 性能与 3× 能效提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Normalizing Flows 在图像生成上已达先进水平，但其重复的串行运算严重受限于 GPU/TPU 的访存与计算/存储效率，存储器瓶颈突出。

Method: 采用 Cu-Cu 混合键合的逻辑die与 M3D DRAM die 集成，提供高密度 bank 与分级、变延迟访问结构；设计混合二值-随机浮点乘法器（尾数在随机域相乘、指数在二值域运算）以提升计算密度并降低面积、能耗与热开销；采用流水化执行策略，将 NF 序列级映射到动态分区的 PE 组上。

Result: 相比现有 PNM 加速器，性能至少提升 6.6×、能效提升 3×；精度上 bits-per-dimension 较 bfloat16 仅增加 2.2%、较 FP32 增加 4.1%；随机硬件变体分析表明更短随机比特流可将执行时间缩短至多 3.3×，但近似误差相应增大。

Conclusion: M3D-FLOW 通过三维堆叠 DRAM 架构与混合二值-随机计算，有效突破 NF 的存储瓶颈并在性能、能效与精度间取得良好折中，同时为延迟-精度权衡提供设计指南。

Abstract: Normalizing Flows (NFs) have shown strong results in generative modeling, recently reaching state-of-the-art image generation performance. However, their repetitive, sequential operations limit the computational and memory efficiency achievable with GPUs and TPUs. We propose M3D-FLOW, a novel monolithic 3D-stackable (M3D) DRAM-based processing-near-memory (PNM) architecture that eliminates memory bottlenecks using a Cu-Cu hybrid-bonded logic die integrated with an M3D DRAM die. The M3D DRAM provides dense bank integration and a tiered organization with variable access latencies that M3D-FLOW exploits for the efficient processing of different NF workloads. To maximize compute density while minimizing area, energy, and thermal overhead, M3D-FLOW employs hybrid binary--stochastic floating-point multipliers, performing mantissa multiplication in the stochastic domain and exponent operations in the binary domain. A pipelined execution strategy maps sequential NF stages across dynamically partitioned PE groups, and together with the stochastic hardware, enables M3D-FLOW to achieve at least $6.6\times$ higher performance and $3\times$ better energy efficiency than prior PNM accelerators, with only a 2.2% bits-per-dimension (BPD) increase over bfloat16 and 4.1% over FP32. An analysis of stochastic hardware variants further shows that shorter stochastic bitstreams reduce execution time by up to $3.3\times$ at the cost of higher approximation error, providing a concrete design guide for latency--accuracy trade-offs.

</details>


### [269] [Green Light: Carbon-Aware Design of Photonic Transformer Accelerators at the Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27376)
*Bharat Bhatta,Ishan Thakkar*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该论文将三种微环谐振器点积单元（AMW、MAW、MWA）适配到Transformer推理，并扩展为随机信号版本共六种组织，在计入制造隐含碳的前提下评估其能耗与碳足迹，发现DPU组织与信号方案比晶圆厂电网更决定碳影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将Transformer推理迁移到边缘端需要同时考虑运行能耗与制造隐含碳，而非仅关注运行能耗；现有基于微环谐振器的DPU面向卷积计算设计，且仅以模拟信号评估、未计入隐含碳。

Method: 将AMW、MAW、MWA三种DPU组织适配Transformer推理负载，并各自扩展出随机信号版本（共六种）；面向5个Transformer模型和4种晶圆厂电网，逐次推理计算隐含碳与运行碳，并与CPU、H100 SXM5 GPU、TPU v5p基线对比，指标包括Energy-Delay、Carbon-Delay、Carbon-Energy Product。

Result: 相对CPU，光子系统在Energy-Delay、Carbon-Delay、Carbon-Energy Product上分别提升约4、4、6个数量级；模拟转随机信号使芯片面积增4.3–4.6倍、隐含碳增4.4–4.8倍，但运行能耗降低约91%，并使每次推理的隐含碳等于或超过运行碳。

Conclusion: DPU组织与信号方案（而非晶圆厂电网）是碳影响的关键决定因素；最快的组织（MWA）不一定最碳高效，而MAW-Stochastic在可持续性与性能间取得较优平衡。

Abstract: Migrating transformer inference to the edge requires sustainability considerations that encompass both operation and manufacturing, rather than operational energy alone.
