Silicon photonics enables high-bandwidth, low-energy matrix multiplication; however, existing microring-resonator-based Dot Product Unit (DPU) organizations have been tailored to convolutional computations and evaluated using analog signaling without accounting for embodied carbon footprints. We adapt three DPU organizations (AMW, MAW, and MWA) to transformer inference workloads and extend each organization to stochastic signaling, yielding six organizations in total. We then calculate their embodied and operational carbon per inference. Across five transformer models and four foundry grids, the photonic system achieves improvements of four, four, and six orders of magnitude in Energy-Delay, Carbon-Delay, and Carbon-Energy Product, respectively, relative to CPUs, while also being compared against H100 SXM5 GPU and TPU v5p baseline systems. Analog-to-stochastic conversion increases die area by 4.3-4.6x and embodied carbon by 4.4-4.8x, while reducing operational energy by approximately 91% and causing embodied carbon to equal or exceed operational carbon per inference. Importantly, the DPU organization and signaling scheme, rather than the foundry grid, are the key determinants of carbon impact. Consequently, the fastest organization (MWA) is not necessarily the most carbon-efficient, whereas MAW-Stochastic offers a favorable balance between sustainability and performance.

</details>


### [270] [Interflow: Breaking the Offline-Online Barrier for Private AI at the Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27431)
*Hanieh Totonchi Asl,Ebrahim Nouri,Zhuoran Li,Danella Zhao*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Interflow 提出算法-硬件协同设计，将相关随机数生成与在线执行按批次流水重叠，把预处理从串行、存储密集的离线阶段转变为持续重叠的流水线，在 ZCU102 上将非线性求值吞吐提升至多 1.55x（CNN）/1.48x（Transformer），端到端 ResNet-50 提升 1.26x、BERT-base 提升 1.21x，内存占用最多降低 37%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PPML 在边缘部署受限于 MPC 的通信、计算与数据搬运开销，尤其非线性推理阶段。现有 MPC 系统将输入无关的相关随机数生成与在线执行解耦，需要缓存大量一次性密码学数据，造成显著内存压力；存储受限时被迫采用"停止-补充"执行模式，反复打断流水线以补充缓冲区，使随机数生成重新进入关键路径。

Method: 提出 Interflow 算法-硬件协同设计，以批处理方式将相关随机数生成与在线执行流水化：当前批次消耗已预生成随机数执行安全非线性运算的同时，为下一批次并发生成相关随机数。结合交织执行（interleaved execution）、高效数据搬运与硬件加速，使相关随机数在接近消费点处生成，从而降低内存占用与数据搬运开销。

Result: 在 Zynq UltraScale+ ZCU102 上实现，相较基线框架：CNN 算子非线性求值吞吐最多提升 1.55x，Transformer 算子最多提升 1.48x；ResNet-50 端到端最多加速 1.26x，BERT-base 最多加速 1.21x；内存占用最多降低 37%。

Conclusion: 将相关随机数预处理由串行、存储密集的离线阶段重构为与在线执行持续重叠的流水线，可有效缓解 MPC 非线性推理中的内存瓶颈与关键路径问题，在边缘 FPGA 平台上实现吞吐提升与内存占用下降的协同收益。

Abstract: Privacy-preserving machine learning (PPML) offers a promising path toward bringing powerful AI services to the edge without exposing sensitive user data. However, its practical deployment remains constrained by the high communication, computation, and data-movement costs of secure multi-party computation (MPC), particularly during nonlinear inference. Existing MPC systems typically decouple input-independent correlated randomness generation from online execution, creating substantial memory pressure to buffer single-use cryptographic data. Moreover, limited storage can force a stop-and-refill execution pattern that repeatedly stalls the pipeline to replenish these buffers, bringing randomness generation back onto the critical path. We propose Interflow, an algorithm-hardware co-design that rethinks this separation by batch-wise processing and pipelining correlated-randomness generation with online execution: while the current batch consumes pre-generated randomness to execute secure nonlinear operations, correlation generation proceeds concurrently for the next batch. By leveraging interleaved execution, efficient data movement, and hardware acceleration, the design transforms preprocessing from a serialized, storage-intensive offline phase into a continuously overlapped pipeline that generates correlated randomness closer to the point of consumption, reducing memory footprint and data movement overhead. Implemented on the Zynq UltraScale+ ZCU102, Interflow improves nonlinear evaluation throughput by up to 1.55x for CNN operators and 1.48x for transformer operators. It achieves up to 1.26x speedup for ResNet-50 and up to 1.21x speedup for BERT-base, and reduces memory footprint by up to 37%, compared with baseline frameworks.

</details>


### [271] [ZKPU: Zero-Knowledge Processing Unit for Heterogeneous Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27530)
*Jonathan Ku,Changchun Zhou,Jiawen Wu,Sangouk Jeon,Cong Guo,Yuzhe Fu,Bowen Duan,Dongsuk Jeon,JV Rajendran,Yiran Chen,Hai Li*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: ZKPU是一种可重构零知识证明处理器，通过将细粒度集成乘积扫描（FIPS）Montgomery乘法与可重构Twin Systolic Fabric（TSF）协同设计，实现以64位为增量的任意宽度模乘，统一支持曲线类与哈希类ZKP协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ZKP硬件加速器基于operand-scanning Montgomery乘法，导致数据通路固定、跨异构操作数宽度利用率低、可扩展性差，只能专用于单一协议族（曲线类大有限域 vs 哈希类原生64位域），无法兼顾两类异构负载。

Method: 提出FIPS Montgomery乘法与可重构Twin Systolic Fabric协同设计，支持64位增量任意宽度模乘；配合细粒度Deque缓冲、片上twiddle因子生成器以及内存高效的MSM预处理策略，构建统一的ZKP加速架构。

Result: 基于Groth16与Plonky2评估：NTT最高144×加速，MSM 13.6×，端到端应用约7.2×加速，优于现有最先进加速器，且为首个在单一可重构硬件平台上高效支持两类协议族的架构。

Conclusion: 通过计算范式与硬件结构的协同设计，ZKPU解决了跨协议族的操作数宽度异构问题，验证了单平台统一加速曲线类与哈希类ZKP的可行性与显著收益。

Abstract: Zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) have become a fundamental building block for privacy-preserving computation, blockchain systems, and verifiable machine learning. Modern ZKP protocols span two distinct families: curve-based protocols, which rely on large finite-field arithmetic, and hash-based protocols, which operate over native 64-bit fields. Existing hardware accelerators are specialized for one protocol family because they are built on operand-scanning Montgomery multiplication, resulting in fixed-width datapaths, poor utilization across heterogeneous operand widths, and limited scalability.
  This paper presents \emph{ZKPU}, a Zero-Knowledge Processing Unit for heterogeneous ZKP workloads. ZKPU introduces a new compute paradigm by co-designing finely integrated product scanning (FIPS) Montgomery multiplication with a reconfigurable Twin Systolic Fabric (TSF), enabling modular multiplication at arbitrary widths in 64-bit increments. Combined with a fine-grained Deque buffer, on-chip twiddle-factor generator, and memory-efficient MSM preprocessing strategy, ZKPU provides a unified architecture for both curve-based and hash-based protocols. Evaluation using Groth16 and Plonky2 shows that ZKPU achieves up to $144\times$ speedup for NTT, $13.6\times$ for MSM, and approximately $7.2\times$ end-to-end application speedup over state-of-the-art accelerators, while being the first architecture to efficiently support both protocol families on a single reconfigurable hardware platform.

</details>


### [272] [DiffRMST: A GPU-Accelerated Fully Differentiable Rectilinear Minimum Spanning Tree Wirelength Model for Global Placement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28246)
*Fuxing Huang,Hao Ai,Wenxing Zhu,Xinning Liu,Ziran Zhu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出DiffRMST：一种全可微的直角最小生成树（RMST）线长模型，用于解析式全局布局，通过空间平滑与log-sum-exp松弛结合Kirchhoff矩阵树定理实现拓扑感知的闭式梯度，并在ISPD2019上显著降低线长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解析式全局布局需要能准确反映布线互连代价的可微线长目标。HPWL高效但忽略多引脚网络的内部拓扑；RSMT保真度高但其判定问题为NP完全且离散构造难以嵌入梯度优化；RMST虽为多项式时间替代，但因对离散生成树取最小而不可微。因此需要一种既保持RMST拓扑保真度又可微的线长模型。

Method: DiffRMST将空间平滑与log-sum-exp松弛相结合，在多棵生成树上定义连续分布；基于Kirchhoff矩阵树定理，无需显式枚举树即可计算配分函数与边边际概率，从而得到闭式的拓扑感知梯度；为便于集成到解析布局，设计了融合前向-反向算子，并提供并行的CPU与GPU实现。

Result: 在ISPD2019基准套件上，相较加权平均基线，RMST、RSMT与实际布线线长平均分别降低5.0%、3.2%和3.5%，运行时开销可接受；GPU实现在全局布局中相较八线程CPU版本平均获得14.7倍加速。

Conclusion: DiffRMST在保持可接受运行时间的前提下，将RMST的高保真拓扑信息以可微形式引入解析式全局布局，有效改善了多项线长指标；融合算子与GPU加速使其具备实际可用性。

Abstract: Analytical global placement requires a differentiable wirelength objective that accurately reflects routed interconnect cost. The widely used half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL) is efficient but overlooks the internal topology of multi-pin nets. The rectilinear Steiner minimum tree (RSMT) provides higher fidelity, but its underlying decision problem is NP-complete, and its discrete construction precludes direct use in gradient-based optimization. The rectilinear minimum spanning tree (RMST) offers a polynomial-time alternative, but remains nondifferentiable because of minimization over discrete spanning trees. To address these limitations, we present DiffRMST, a fully differentiable RMST wirelength model for analytical global placement. DiffRMST combines spatial smoothing with a log-sum-exp relaxation to define a continuous distribution over spanning trees. Based on the Kirchhoff matrix-tree theorem, the partition function and edge marginals can be computed without explicit tree enumeration, enabling a closed-form topology-aware gradient for placement optimization. For efficient integration into analytical placement, we further develop a fused forward-backward operator with parallel CPU and GPU implementations. On the ISPD2019 benchmark suite, our method reduces RMST, RSMT, and routed wirelength by an average of 5.0%, 3.2%, and 3.5%, respectively, compared with the weighted-average baseline, while maintaining acceptable runtime. Furthermore, the GPU implementation achieves an average $14.7\times$ speedup in global placement over its eight-thread CPU counterpart.

</details>


### [273] [RPolyPlan: A Unified Global Floorplanning and Legalization Framework for Rectilinear Soft Modules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28276)
*Fuxing Huang,Wenxing Zhu,Xinning Liu,Ziran Zhu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: RPolyPlan统一框架将连续可变形直角多边形模块直接纳入全局布局，联合优化形状与位置，在固定轮廓与自由轮廓实验中HPWL分别较SOTA降低7%和6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有直角软模块布局方法先在矩形全局解基础上增量细化生成直角多边形，使多边形探索局限于初始布局邻域，面积利用率与线长优化受限。

Method: 提出结构化连续表示与可微多边形成形模型，依据重叠动态优化模块形状，使连续形状优化可嵌入基于梯度的全局布局；用增广拉格朗日处理耦合不等式约束并提供收敛保证、降低罚参调优依赖；合法化阶段用最小费用流与矩形分解确定子矩形目标面积，以水平/垂直约束图编码几何关系，形成满足面积、形状、分离、连通与轮廓约束的凸合法化模型，最小化芯片面积或与全局解的位移。

Result: 在GSRC、MCNC及ICCAD 2023竞赛基准上，固定轮廓与自由轮廓实验中HPWL分别较所评估的先进方法降低7%与6%。

Conclusion: 直接在全局布局中优化连续可变形直角多边形、并以凸合法化保证约束可行性，是一种有效且理论可证的直角软模块布局范式。

Abstract: Floorplanning with rectilinear soft modules improves area utilization and wirelength by allowing modules to adapt to rectilinear polygon (RPoly) shapes. Existing methods typically construct rectilinear polygons through incremental refinement after obtaining a rectangular global solution, which confines polygon exploration to the neighborhood induced by the initial floorplan. This paper presents RPolyPlan, a unified framework for outline-free and fixed-outline floorplanning that directly incorporates continuously deformable rectilinear polygons into global floorplanning. To enable direct polygon optimization, we introduce a structured continuous representation and a differentiable polygon shaping model that dynamically optimizes rectilinear module shapes based on overlaps, making continuous shape optimization feasible for gradient-based global floorplanning. An augmented Lagrangian formulation robustly handles the coupled inequality constraints, provides theoretical convergence guarantees, and reduces dependence on manual penalty-parameter tuning. During legalization, minimum-cost flow and rectangular decomposition determine the target areas of subrectangles, and horizontal and vertical constraint graphs encode their geometric relations. The resulting convex legalization formulation satisfies the area, shape, separation, connectivity, and outline constraints while minimizing either the chip area or the displacement from the global floorplanning solution. Experiments on the GSRC, MCNC, and ICCAD 2023 contest benchmarks demonstrate that RPolyPlan reduces HPWL over the evaluated state-of-the-art methods by 7% and 6% in fixed-outline and outline-free experiments, respectively.

</details>


<div id='eess.SP'></div>

### [274] [Toroidal-OAM Hybrid Beam for Divergence-Suppressed OAM Wireless Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26921)
*Runyu Lyu,Wenchi Cheng,Xiang Fang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出环形-轨道角动量（toroidal-OAM）混合波束，将同轴喇叭产生的环形电磁脉冲（角向约束强、纵向电场强）与常规OAM波束叠加，降低角向扩散并填充轴上零点；建立三分量加权叠加远场模型，数值与全波仿真验证其在发散抑制、SNR、链路预算和多模功率均衡上的增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OAM波束可提供空间独立复用，但其环形强度随模式阶数增大而发散，在有限口径下造成功率捕获损失与链路预算不均衡，制约OAM无线通信的实用化。

Method: 将环形电磁脉冲（同轴喇叭）的角向约束与强纵向电场，与常规OAM波束叠加，构成混合波束；构建远场模型为三项加权叠加：OAM均匀圆阵（UCA）辐射、超高斯环形角向包络、零阶贝塞尔纵向场，由三个与可测硬件关联的无量纲参数（环形约束、耦合强度、纵向系数）控制；进行3 GHz、5λ口径数值计算，并与ANSYS HFSS全波仿真对照。

Result: ℓ=1–4模式发散降低12–41%，ℓ≥5时波束完全中心峰化；固定kR、κ、α、β、ℓ时抑制比不变；链路评估显示接收SNR增益6.4–30.9 dB，固定效率链路预算范围扩展超108%，多模功率不均衡降低达五个数量级；中心零点填充至峰值的8–100%；不产生模间串扰，环定义良好处目标模功率占比>0.54；z=500λ处模分复用容量最高提升2.1倍（107%）；HFSS仿真证实混合发射器保持OAM涡旋相位并降低发散。

Conclusion: 环形波束工程可作为OAM无线链路的实用设计工具，在保持涡旋相位的同时改善发散、功率均衡与容量。

Abstract: Orbital angular momentum (OAM) beams offer spatially independent multiplexing in wireless communications, but their donut-shaped intensity diverges with mode order, causing power capture loss at finite apertures and unequal link budgets. We propose a toroidal-OAM hybrid beam that combines the angular confinement and strong longitudinal electric field of toroidal electromagnetic pulses from a coaxial horn with a conventional OAM beam, lowering angular spread and producing non-zero on-axis intensity. A far-field model is built as a weighted superposition of OAM uniform circular array (UCA) radiation, a super-Gaussian toroidal angular envelope, and a zeroth-order Bessel longitudinal field, controlled by three dimensionless parameters (toroidal confinement, coupling strength, longitudinal coefficient) tied to measurable hardware. Numerical results at 3 GHz with a $5λ$ aperture show 12--41% divergence reduction for OAM modes $\ell = 1$--$4$, while modes $\ell \geq 5$ become fully center-peaked. The suppression ratio stays unchanged for fixed $kR$, $κ$, $α$, $β$, and $\ell$. Link evaluation shows 6.4--30.9 dB received SNR gain, over 108% extension in fixed-efficiency link-budget range, and up to five orders of magnitude reduction in multi-mode power imbalance. The central null is filled to 8--100% of the peak; the hybrid beam does not mix OAM modes, with intended-mode power fraction above $0.54$ where the ring is well-defined. OAM mode-division multiplexing capacity at $z=500λ$ shows up to $2.1\times$ ($107\%$) capacity enhancement. Full-wave simulation in ANSYS HFSS corroborates the model, confirming the hybrid launcher preserves the OAM vortex phase while reducing divergence compared with a UCA-only baseline. These findings establish toroidal beam engineering as a practical tool for OAM-based wireless links.

</details>


### [275] [QoS-Aware Joint 1-Bit RIS Element Activation and Fluid-Antenna Port Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27291)
*Khalid Yahya,Mahmoud Aldababsa*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文将流体天线端口选择、固定基数RIS单元激活与1-bit反射相位联合优化，基于精确角度事件扫描把全激活的分治排序几何推广到子集选择，并给出增益界、中断与分集结论及开销条件下净能效的提升判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全激活RIS在相关信道下未必最优且引入过多导频/切换开销，需要在保证QoS与中断性能的前提下联合优化流体天线端口、RIS单元子集及1-bit相位，以提升净能量效率。

Method: 提出精确的角度事件扫描算法，将全激活下的divide-and-sort几何推广至子集选择，联合确定端口选择、固定基数单元激活与1-bit反射相位；建立确定性增益界与激活单调性，推导单单元精确中断表达式及相关接收端口下独立RIS支路的高SNR渐近；对固定正定RIS协方差证明分集阶数等于单元数；设计QoS感知的最小激活策略，并给出显式开销条件判定降激活是否提升净能效。

Result: 得到确定性增益界与激活单调性；单单元精确中断与高SNR渐近闭式；固定正定协方差下分集阶数等于RIS单元数；QoS感知策略在保持全激活中断概率的同时以最少单元数达标；给出降激活提升净能效的显式开销条件，并通过相关信道基准验证子集选择增益、孔径效应与开销相关的能效折中。

Conclusion: 将角度事件扫描用于流体天线—RIS联合子集选择可在维持中断性能的同时降低激活开销，分集由RIS单元数决定，降激活的净能效收益取决于显式开销条件。

Abstract: This letter jointly optimizes fluid-antenna port selection, fixed-cardinality reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) element activation, and 1-bit reflection phases through an exact angular event sweep that extends full-activation divide-and-sort geometry to subset selection. We establish deterministic gain bounds and activation monotonicity, derive exact single-element outage expressions and high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) asymptotics for independent RIS branches with correlated receiving ports, and prove diversity order equal to the RIS element count for fixed positive-definite RIS covariance. With perfect instantaneous channel state information, a quality-of-service aware policy activates the minimum number of elements required to meet a target SNR while preserving full-activation outage probability. An explicit overhead condition identifies when reduced activation improves net energy efficiency. Correlated-channel benchmarks illustrate subset-selection gains, aperture effects, and overhead-dependent energy-efficiency tradeoffs.

</details>


### [276] [Variational Blind Equalization for Dual-Polarization Free-Space Quantum Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27358)
*Anders M. Buvarp,Stefan Werner*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文研究了双偏振自由空间量子通信链路在偏振混叠、衰落、相位变化和有限信道监督下的接收机均衡问题，基于变分自编码器的概率物理参数估计器VISTA，考察了盲与半盲均衡，并系统比较了多种KL型正则化目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双偏振自由空间量子通信链路存在偏振混叠、衰落、相位漂移且信道监督有限，常规接收机均衡难以适用；同时半盲估计中随机变分目标的方向性（前向/反向KL）与正则权重如何影响信道估计误差尚不明确。

Method: 提出基于VISTA（用于信号跟踪与自适应的变分推断）的变分盲/半盲均衡：半盲分支将信道相关统计量映射到2×2复偏振信道，比较前向KL、反向KL、Average Jeffreys、Max-KL与自适应Jeffreys正则化，分析KL方向不对称性及正则权重ζ的局部效应；另设完全盲QPSK接收机，仅由接收数据直接估计均衡器，并与CMA加分离基线对比（Adam直接W优化消融）。

Result: 500次配对蒙特卡洛试验中，前向KL对ζ几乎不敏感，反向与对称目标出现低误差区间后随正则增强而退化；ζ=3×10^-5时Average Jeffreys较同权重前向KL使中位信道NRMSE降低约4.8%；KL不对称性减小并不必然带来更低信道误差。3000次配对试验中，各VISTA变体中位对齐块NMSE几乎一致，其相对CMA加分离基线的平均误差降低集中于困难的大误差试验，且Adam直接W优化可复现大部分平均降幅；完全盲基准中弱正则化未带来可分辨的改进。

Conclusion: 对称/反向KL正则化在适当权重下可小幅改善半盲信道估计精度，但KL不对称性并非可靠误差指标；完全盲场景下弱正则化收益不显著，VISTA相对基线的主要优势体现在困难样本与大误差尾部，且多可由直接W优化解释。

Abstract: Dual-polarization free-space quantum communication links require receiver equalization under polarization mixing, fading, phase variation, and limited channel supervision. This paper investigates variational blind and semi-blind equalization using VISTA (Variational Inference for Signal Tracking and Adaptation), a variational autoencoder-based probabilistic physical parameter estimator. In the semi-blind branch, channel-relevant statistics are mapped to the underlying 2x2 complex polarization channel. We compare forward KL, reverse KL, Average Jeffreys, Max-KL, and Adaptive Jeffreys regularization and analyze directional KL asymmetry and the local effect of the regularization weight zeta. Over 500 paired Monte Carlo trials, forward KL is nearly insensitive to zeta, whereas reverse and symmetric objectives exhibit low-error regions followed by degradation under stronger regularization. At zeta = 3 x 10^-5, Average Jeffreys reduces median channel NRMSE by approximately 4.8% relative to forward KL at the same weight. Reduced KL asymmetry does not necessarily imply lower channel error. A separate fully blind QPSK receiver estimates a direct equalizer from received data only. Over 3000 paired trials, the VISTA variants have nearly identical median aligned block-NMSE, while their lower mean aligned block-NMSE relative to the CMA-plus-separation baseline is concentrated in difficult, large-error trials. Direct-W optimization with Adam reproduces most of this mean reduction. In the fully blind benchmark, the tested weak regularizers provide no resolved improvement over unregularized VISTA.

</details>


### [277] [Quaternion-Valued Adaptive Projection Statistics for Neural Receivers in Dual-Polarization Free-Space Quantum Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27363)
*Anders M. Buvarp,Stefan Werner*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 论文针对双偏振自由空间量子通信接收机输出的两路耦合复外差流，提出四元数域鲁棒接收方法与干扰诊断统计量，并在神经网络实验中对比实数、复数、四元数及宽线性复数接收机在清洁与污染条件下的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双偏振自由空间量子通信链路面临衰落、偏振混合、校准失配与脉冲污染等非高斯扰动，传统复数接收机难以统一刻画四偏振—正交分量的耦合结构，且对非高斯污染敏感。

Method: 将四路偏振与正交分量编码为四元数样本，建立可辨识的有效信道模型；提出四元数投影统计量（QVPS）及自适应QVPS（AQVPS），在样本级投影离群度基础上融合鲁棒局部二阶描述子；复数与四元数信道估计采用径向Huber加权；以QVPS与AQVPS分别作为扰动诊断量，并进行描述子单独消融；神经网络实验对比匹配的实值、复值、四元数及宽线性复值接收机，并做激活函数匹配对照实验。

Result: 鲁棒估计降低了对非高斯污染的敏感性；局部二阶描述子相对QVPS提升了对所测局部化扰动的检测能力，描述子单独消融略优于完整AQVPS；清洁高斯信噪比扫描中复数LMMSE评估MSE最低，而在污染扫描中四元数神经网络（按其标称激活）平均评估MSE最低；激活匹配实验表明四元数网络的鲁棒性很大程度源于有界激活而非四元数参数化本身。

Conclusion: 四元数鲁棒接收与QVPS/AQVPS诊断框架可有效处理偏振耦合与非高斯扰动；但性能增益主要归因于有界激活等实现因素，且方法仅在接收机处理层面评估，不构成可组合的CV-QKD安全性证明。

Abstract: Dual-polarization free-space quantum communication receivers produce two coupled complex heterodyne streams. We develop robust quaternion receiver methods for such links under fading, polarization mixing, calibration mismatch, impulsive contamination, and other non-Gaussian disturbances. The four polarization and quadrature components are encoded as quaternion-valued samples. We formulate an identifiable effective channel model, Quaternion-Valued Projection Statistics (QVPS), and Adaptive QVPS (AQVPS), which augments samplewise projection outlyingness with robust local second-order descriptors. Robust complex and quaternion channel estimators use radial Huber weighting, while QVPS and AQVPS are evaluated separately as disturbance diagnostics. Neural experiments compare matched real-, complex-, quaternion-, and widely linear complex-valued receivers. Robust estimation reduces sensitivity to non-Gaussian contamination. Local second-order descriptors improve detection of the tested localized disturbances relative to QVPS, and a descriptor-only ablation slightly outperforms full AQVPS. Complex LMMSE gives the lowest evaluation MSE in the clean Gaussian SNR sweep, whereas the Quaternion NN, among the compared receivers with their nominal activations, gives the lowest mean evaluation MSE in the tested contaminated sweeps. Activation-matched experiments indicate that much of the nominal Quaternion NN robustness is attributable to bounded activation rather than quaternion parameterization alone. The methods are evaluated at the receiver processing level and do not constitute a composable CV-QKD security proof.

</details>


### [278] [Structured PARAFAC Channel Estimation for Flexible Intelligent Metasurface Receivers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27445)
*Xi Han,Junqiao Chen,Yuansheng Zhang,André L. F. de Almeida,George C. Alexandropoulos*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 基于结构化PARAFAC模型，提出针对柔性智能超表面（FIM）上行信道的确定性非迭代闭式估计方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FIM通过口径形变获得几何多样性，但响应随配置变化，使上行信道估计复杂；同时多用户共享同一角度响应的结构未被充分利用。

Method: 在已校准的FIM多个配置上构建结构化PARAFAC模型，利用已知单位因子与秩一导频加权信道因子，经逐阵元秩一逼近、参考态归一化、全局秩一投影及最小二乘形变因子更新实现确定性、非迭代的代数因子恢复；再将空间与形变因子联合匹配校准流形以估计公共角度、用户增益及配置相关信道。

Result: 仿真表明可准确恢复因子；面外形变可消除未形变平面口径的方位角符号模糊；角度扩展实验量化了放松公共响应假设时的失配程度。

Conclusion: 结构化PARAFAC建模为FIM上行信道估计提供了低复杂度、无需迭代与训练的高效方案，并揭示了形变带来的可辨识性增益及其假设边界。

Abstract: Flexible intelligent metasurfaces (FIMs) create geometric diversity through aperture morphing, but their configuration-dependent responses complicate uplink channel estimation. This letter considers multiple users sharing a common angular response and develops a structured PARAFAC model across calibrated FIM configurations. Its known identity factor and rank-one pilot-weighted channel factor enable deterministic, noniterative algebraic factor recovery through per-element rank-one approximations, reference-state normalization, global rank-one projection, and a least-squares morphing-factor update. The recovered spatial and morphing factors are then jointly matched to the calibrated manifold to estimate the common angles, user gains, and configuration-dependent channels. Simulations demonstrate accurate recovery and show that out-of-plane morphing resolves the azimuth-sign ambiguity of an undeformed planar aperture; an angular-spread experiment quantifies the mismatch when the common-response assumption is relaxed.

</details>


### [279] [RMSampler: Sparse Radio Map Reconstruction with Active Sampling and Diffusion Posterior Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27464)
*Nan Cheng,Xiucheng Wang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出RMSampler联合采样与重建方法，在有限测量预算下提升无线电地图重建精度与干扰源定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏接收功率测量下，全局无线电地图与干扰源位置均存在不确定性，使得信息性采样与精确重建均困难，且两类误差量纲不同难以统一决策。

Method: 采样阶段基于扩散生成地图的协方差评估全局RM误差下降、基于候选干扰源位置评估定位误差下降，将两者的期望相对下降组合为尺度不变采样准则，每次测量同时更新两类不确定性；重建阶段用更新后的源位置概率引导独立的扩散集成，并以有效样本量(ESS)目标进行稳健后验校正，再以最小失真投影施加测量与建筑约束。

Result: 理论分析表明提高似然幂次可降低期望稳健测量损失且不改变预训练参数与结构；仿真与实测数据在同等测量预算下均优于基线；重庆实测中相对随机采样，RMSE由3.54 dB降至2.73 dB。

Conclusion: 联合主动采样与条件扩散集成的框架能有效利用稀疏测量，实现更准确的RM重建与源定位，具备实际部署可行性。

Abstract: Reconstructing a radio map (RM) from sparse received-power measurements supports non-cooperative interference monitoring and spectrum management. However,sparse measurements leave uncertainty about both the global RM and the interfering emitter location, making informative sampling and accurate reconstruction challenging. To address these challenges, a novel joint sampling and reconstruction method named RMSampler is proposed in this paper to improve measurement selection and RM reconstruction under limited measurement budgets. For measurement selection, RMSampler evaluates global RM error reduction using the covariance of diffusion-generated RMs and localization error reduction using candidate emitter locations. Because these errors have different units, their expected relative reductions are combined into a scale-invariant sampling criterion, with each acquired measurement updating both uncertainty estimates. After sampling, the updated emitter-location probabilities guide a separate conditional diffusion ensemble for final reconstruction. To improve measurement agreement, an effective sample size (ESS) target guides robust posterior correction, followed by a minimum-distortion projection enforcing measurement and building constraints. For the reconstruction ensemble, analysis establishes that increasing likelihood power reduces expected robust measurement loss, while pretrained neural parameters and architecture remain unchanged. Experiments using simulated and real-world measured data demonstrate improved reconstruction under matched measurement budgets. In the Chongqing real-world measured data experiment, root mean square error (RMSE) decreases from 3.54 to 2.73~dB relative to random sampling under a common reconstruction method.

</details>


### [280] [Multi-Threshold Sampling: Local and Global Parameter Identifiability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27665)
*Ao Qiu,Qingguo Xie*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 研究多阈值(MT)采样记录阈值穿越时间能否唯一确定信号参数，以及所需阈值数量；给出了基于秩的局部/全局可辨识性判据，并证明四强度参数的Poisson模型用单个足够小的正阈值即可实现可辨识，达到阈值数下限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MT采样在PET、测井、光子计数X射线成像等中用于参数估计，但"记录到的穿越时间分布能否唯一确定参数"以及"需要多少阈值"缺乏理论保证。

Method: 证明分布对参数的导数秩在穿越、计时与选择过程中不会增加；在正则性假设下用有限个事件概率的Jacobian满秩刻画局部可辨识性，并在额外秩与拓扑假设下给出充要的全局可辨识判据；针对含四个强度参数的非齐次Poisson信号模型（固定已知单光子响应、确定性MT采样），用首个记录穿越时间的四个累积概率证明局部与全局可辨识性。

Result: 四个累积概率在各自条件下即可确立局部与全局可辨识性，且仅需单个足够小的正阈值，达到该模型与采样器所需阈值数的最小值；数值实验验证结论，同时揭示参数敏感性弱、有限样本估计误差显著。

Conclusion: MT采样下的参数唯一性可以严格建立，但可辨识性不等于统计可估计性；实际估计精度受灵敏度与有限样本效应制约。

Abstract: Multi-threshold (MT) sampling records threshold-crossing times for parameter estimation in applications including positron emission tomography, oil well logging, and photon-counting X-ray imaging. We study whether the distribution of recorded crossings uniquely determines the signal parameters and how many thresholds are required for this identifiability. For a fixed MT sampler, we show that the ranks of distribution derivatives with respect to the parameters cannot increase through crossing, timing, and selection. Under suitable regularity assumptions, we characterize local identifiability by a full-rank Jacobian of finitely many event probabilities defined on recorded crossings and establish a necessary and sufficient global identifiability criterion under additional rank and topological assumptions. For a nonhomogeneous Poisson signal model with four intensity parameters, a fixed known single-photon response, and deterministic MT sampling, we prove that four cumulative probabilities of the first recorded crossing time establish local and global identifiability under their respective conditions using a single sufficiently small positive threshold. This attains the minimum number of thresholds for the specified model and sampler. Numerical experiments illustrate these results and reveal weak parameter sensitivity and substantial finite-sample estimation errors when estimation uses these probabilities. The results establish parameter uniqueness while highlighting the role of statistical sensitivity in accurate estimation.

</details>


### [281] [Revolutionizing 6G Wireless Networks with RISs: Enhancements in Sensing and Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27695)
*Jiguang He,Yuwen Cao,Charles Vanwynsberghe,Aymen Fakhreddine,Yi Fang,Chongwen Huang,George C. Alexandropoulos,Merouane Debbah*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文综述可重构智能表面（RIS）赋能通感一体化（ISAC）的基本原理、潜在应用与未来趋势，指出RIS将成为6G时代ISAC的关键使能技术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RIS具备低成本、低功耗、部署灵活和大有效孔径等优势，已被证明可提升覆盖、和速率、干扰抑制与安全性；而6G中无线感知将与通信并重，因此需要探讨RIS如何支撑通信与感知的无缝融合。

Method: 综述性分析：梳理RIS的核心原理与在通信中的增益，并从被动感知与主动感知两种范式出发，阐述RIS辅助ISAC的实现思路、典型应用场景与发展趋势。

Result: 论文归纳了RIS同时增强通信与感知能力的机制，明确了RIS可通过被动与主动感知范式支持通感一体化，并识别出若干潜在应用与研究方向。

Conclusion: RIS赋能的ISAC有望成为6G网络的关键使能技术，后续需在关键理论与应用层面深入研究以推动落地。

Abstract: Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) have emerged as one of the most promising technologies for the next-generation wireless networks, offering advantages such as cost efficiency, low power consumption, flexible deployment, and large effective aperture. Extensive studies have demonstrated the capabilities of RISs to enhance communication performance, including coverage extension, sum-rate improvement, interference suppression, security enhancement, etc. As 6G networks continue to evolve, wireless sensing is expected to play a pivotal role alongside communication. Undoubtedly, RISs possess great potential to enable seamless integration of sensing and communication by supporting both passive and active sensing paradigms. This paper explores how RISs can revolutionize wireless networks by enhancing both communication and sensing capabilities. Specifically, we highlight the fundamental principles, potential applications, and future trends of RIS-assisted integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), anticipating that RIS-enabled ISAC will become a key enabler in the upcoming 6G era.

</details>


### [282] [When Every Bit Counts in Quantized Beamforming: From CSI Feedback to Low-Resolution Hardware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27923)
*Yasaman Khorsandmanesh,Parisa Ramezani,Emil Bjornson*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文为综述/观点文章，系统梳理MIMO波束成形中贯穿信号链（CSI反馈、前传、权值、DAC/ADC、有限精度移相器）的量化损伤来源、性能影响与缓解策略，并给出代表性数值示例，指出量化应作为显式建模的设计要素而非事后修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MIMO性能分析常基于理想硬件假设，而实际系统中量化广泛存在于CSI反馈、前传信令、波束成形系数、数据转换器和有限分辨率移相器等环节；这些损伤相互耦合，会改变可用信道信息、约束可行发射信号，从而限制波束成形增益与干扰抑制能力，故需要一个统一视角加以审视。

Method: 视角性综述：按量化来源组织文献，讨论基于码本的CSI反馈、量化感知波束成形、低分辨率转换器建模、有限分辨率混合波束成形；并结合代表性数值示例说明量化何时成为主导性能瓶颈。

Result: 通过数值示例刻画了量化在不同配置下成为主要性能瓶颈的条件；归纳出量化对波束成形增益与干扰抑制的联合约束效应，并给出缓解手段的效果对比。

Conclusion: 有限分辨率效应应被显式建模并纳入波束成形设计，而非作为事后补偿；未来方向包括联合波束成形与量化设计、自适应分辨率架构以及具离散硬件约束的新型天线技术。

Abstract: Multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) is a key technology in modern wireless networks, but its performance is often analyzed under ideal hardware assumptions. In practical implementations, however, quantization appears throughout the signal-processing chain, including channel state information (CSI) feedback, fronthaul signaling, beamforming coefficients, data converters, and finite-resolution phase shifters. These impairments do not act independently: they alter the channel information available for beamforming, constrain the feasible transmit signals, and can ultimately limit beamforming gain and interference suppression. This article provides a perspective on quantized beamforming by connecting its main sources, performance implications, and mitigation strategies. We discuss codebook-based CSI feedback, quantization-aware beamforming, low-resolution converter modeling, and finite-resolution hybrid beamforming, and use representative numerical examples to illustrate when quantization becomes a dominant performance bottleneck. We further highlight emerging directions in joint beamforming and quantization design, adaptive-resolution architectures, and new antenna technologies with discrete hardware constraints. The key message is that finite-resolution effects should be modeled explicitly and incorporated into the beamforming design rather than treated as an afterthought.

</details>


### [283] [RIS Configuration with Low-Overhead Measurements via Physics-Guided Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27972)
*Son Dinh-Van,Matthew D. Higgins*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 针对SISO链路中RIS配置的两阶段“先估计后优化”流程，硬件实验发现明显的块间相位漂移（疑似残余CFO），会严重损害基于导频的信道估计；基于RSS的方法对相位旋转更鲁棒但测量量需求大，作者提出参数化物理引导神经盲波束成形（P-PGNBB），以显著更少的RSS测量逼近完美CSI的接收SNR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RIS配置依赖信道信息，而实际硬件中导频估计易受残余CFO导致的块间相位演化影响，RSS估计虽鲁棒却测量开销大，需要在保证性能的前提下降低RSS测量数量。

Method: 采用“先估计后优化”框架，比较导频式与RSS式两种估计途径；通过硬件实验刻画块间相位漂移，并用仿真评估其对导频估计的退化；进而提出P-PGNBB，将物理模型参数化与神经网络结合用于RSS盲波束成形。

Result: 仿真与硬件实验显示：未补偿的相位旋转使导频估计严重退化，RSS方法受影响较小；P-PGNBB在显著减少RSS测量次数的同时，接收SNR接近完美CSI方案，并与现有方法相当。

Conclusion: 硬件相位不理想性使RSS类估计更具实用价值，P-PGNBB以物理引导的参数化学习有效缓解RSS测量开销问题，为实际RIS系统配置提供了低开销、近最优的方案。

Abstract: This paper studies reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) configuration for a single-input single-output (SISO) communication link using a two-stage estimate-then-optimize procedure. Within this framework, two common approaches to the estimation stage are pilot-based channel estimation and received signal strength (RSS)-based channel estimation. Our hardware experiments reveal substantial inter-block phase evolution consistent with residual CFO, while simulations show that such phase rotations can severely degrade pilot-based channel estimation when left uncompensated. In contrast, RSS-based approaches are less affected by these phase rotations, although they often require a large number of measurements to achieve a near-optimal received signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). To address this measurement requirement, we propose parametric physics-guided neural blind beamforming (\textsc{P-PGNBB}) for RSS-based channel estimation. Simulations and hardware experiments confirm that the proposed method achieves a received SNR close to that obtained with perfect channel state information (CSI) and comparable to existing methods, while requiring substantially fewer RSS measurements.

</details>


### [284] [Diffusion MRI protocol design for reliable parameter recovery: a unified framework across biophysical models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28099)
*Ekin Taskin,Jonathan Rafael-Patiño,Erick Jorge Canales-Rodríguez,Jean-Philippe Thiran*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出POLAR框架，通过端到端优化连续采集空间并直接最小化多参数恢复误差来设计dMRI采集协议，在多种微结构模型上显著优于参考设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: dMRI微结构参数估计的可靠性高度依赖采集协议，但常用协议设计准则难以充分反映估计器偏差、参数约束及复杂反问题中的非线性拟合行为。

Method: POLAR为端到端框架：在连续采集空间中搜索，通过带噪信号仿真与所选模型拟合，直接最小化多参数恢复误差（估计器感知、模型特定）。

Result: 在独立留出参数集上，POLAR一致优于各模型专用参考设计：Cylinder-Zeppelin的RMSE最多降低50%，CEXI最多降低74%，NEXI交换时间偏差降低70%。

Conclusion: 跨不同生物物理模型、采集设置与参考设计策略的增益表明，以下游参数估计问题为导向优化采集协议具有明显优势；POLAR为针对目标微结构参数与实验条件定制dMRI协议提供了灵活、模型特定且估计器感知的框架。

Abstract: Reliable microstructural parameter estimation in diffusion MRI (dMRI) critically depends on the acquisition protocol. Yet, common protocol design criteria may not fully reflect estimator bias, parameter constraints, and nonlinear fitting behavior in complex inverse problems. Here, we introduce Protocol Optimization via Loss Assessing Parameter Recovery (POLAR), an end-to-end framework that searches the continuous acquisition space and directly minimizes multiparameter recovery error through noisy signal simulation and the chosen model fitting. We demonstrate POLAR spanning distinct microstructural environments: the Cylinder-Zeppelin model for white matter, Neurite Exchange Imaging (NEXI) for gray matter, and Cellular Exchange Imaging (CEXI) for permeable cells. Across independent held-out parameter sets, POLAR consistently outperformed model-specific reference designs, reducing RMSE by up to $50\%$ for Cylinder-Zeppelin and $74\%$ for CEXI, while reducing NEXI exchange time bias by $70\%$. These gains across distinct biophysical models, acquisition settings, and reference design strategies demonstrate the benefit of optimizing acquisition protocols through the downstream parameter-estimation problem. POLAR provides a flexible, model-specific and estimator-aware framework for designing dMRI protocols tailored to the microstructural parameters and experimental conditions of interest.

</details>


### [285] [Negative Log-Shifted Gamma: A Generalized Pointing Error Model for Directional Wideband Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28101)
*Evla S. Ahrazoglu,Ahmet C. Gul,Mehmet N. Akinci,Ibrahim Altunbas,Eylem Erdogan*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出一种涵盖抖动、AoD/AoA估计误差及多项设计因素（移相器量化、天线方向图、阵列结构、波束成形架构、转向能力、带宽）的指向误差模型，证明其服从负对数移位Gamma（NLSG）分布，具有闭式统计表达式并通过多项指标验证其精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高定向通信系统中，指向误差（轻微失对准即导致接收功率严重下降）至关重要，但现有指向误差模型受限于分布假设与设计约束，无法覆盖多样化的实际场景。

Method: 分别对高增益与低增益配置建模天线方向图；将阵列因子主瓣近似为高斯波束，适用于子阵与超阵，并涵盖宽带系统中模拟/数字波束成形阶段及波束斜视的存在或补偿；通过三维旋转引入抖动与估计误差，通过阵列相位激励刻画移相量化，最终推导出指向误差服从NLSG分布。

Result: NLSG分布仅由形状、尺度、位置三个参数完全刻画，具备闭式统计表达式；通过归一化矩误差、Jensen-Shannon散度与Kolmogorov-Smirnov统计量验证，误差值主要分别低于1%、0.02和0.05；容量分析表明特定设计选择对实现最优容量至关重要。

Conclusion: 该模型数学上可处理、可扩展，适用于系统设计与分析；论文给出了高定向宽带通信系统的设计准则以缓解指向误差的不利影响，为鲁棒的下一代网络奠定基础。

Abstract: Pointing error is critical in highly directional communication systems, where even slight misalignment leads to severe received power reduction. Existing pointing error models fail to cover diverse practical scenarios due to restrictive distributional and design limitations. This paper proposes a novel pointing error model incorporating jitters, AoD/AoA estimation errors, and comprehensive design impacts, including phase shifter quantization, antenna patterns, array design, beamforming architectures, steering capabilities, and bandwidth. To accomplish this, antenna patterns are modeled for both high- and low-gain configurations. Then, the array factor's main lobe is approximated as a Gaussian beam for subarrays and superarrays, accommodating analog and digital beamforming stages in wideband systems under beam squint presence or compensation. Jitters and estimation errors are incorporated via 3D rotations, while phase shift quantization is captured through the phase excitations of the arrays. It is shown that the resulting pointing error follows a novel distribution: the negative log-shifted Gamma (NLSG). Fully characterized by only shape, scale, and location parameters, the NLSG features closed-form statistical expressions. This formulation ensures tractable mathematical manipulation, making it a practical, scalable tool for system design and analysis. Validation via normalized moment error, Jensen-Shannon divergence, and Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistics confirms exceptional accuracy, yielding values primarily below 1%, 0.02, and 0.05, respectively. Furthermore, capacity analysis has demonstrated that specific design choices are paramount for achieving optimal capacity. Finally, important guidelines for designing highly directional wideband communication systems are provided to mitigate the detrimental effects of pointing errors, thereby paving the way for robust next-generation networks.

</details>


### [286] [Interference-Graph-Aided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Beam Hopping LEO Satellite Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28248)
*Hao Yuan,Ziyi Yang,Xing Zhang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出干扰图辅助的多智能体强化学习方法，将波束耦合结构先验注入智能体表征学习，实现跳波束调度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO卫星跳波束需应对非均匀业务需求下的动态波束覆盖，但波束间严重的空间干扰耦合使协同调度困难。

Method: 构建干扰图刻画波束间耦合关系，各波束智能体在估计局部Q值前先通过图卷积聚合干扰邻居信息，再交由标准混合网络进行值分解（基于QMIX框架）。

Result: 在非均匀业务与同频干扰场景下，吞吐量较QMIX提升34.4%，且干扰管理更稳定。

Conclusion: 将干扰图结构先验嵌入多智能体表征学习，可有效缓解波束耦合带来的协同调度难题，提升吞吐量并改善干扰管理稳定性。

Abstract: Beam hopping technology enables LEO satellites to dynamically switch beam coverage positions, providing flexible resource allocation for non-uniformly distributed traffic demands. However, the severe spatial interference coupling among beams makes coordinated scheduling challenging. To address this problem, in this letter, we propose an interference-graph-aided multi-agent reinforcement learning approach that constructs an interference graph to capture beam coupling relationships and injects this structural prior into agent-side representation learning. Each beam agent aggregates information from interference neighbors via graph convolution before estimating local Q-values, which are then decomposed by the standard mixing network. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves 34.4\% higher throughput than QMIX with more stable interference management, under non-uniform traffic and co-channel interference settings.

</details>


### [287] [Uncertainty-Aware Distributed Radio Map Estimation in Decentralized Wireless Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28293)
*Dong Yang,Zhuoyu Yao,Yue Wang,Songyang Zhang,Yingshu Li,Zhi Tian,Zhipeng Cai*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出不确定性感知的分布式无线电地图估计框架UA-D-RME：节点只交换低维统计信息（重叠区域的无线电地图与不确定性度量），通过不确定性感知统计共识迭代对齐概率模型，实现去中心化、低通信开销的RME。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦学习RME需频繁交换高维模型更新且依赖中心服务器进行协调与聚合，通信开销过高，难以适用于带宽受限的移动与无线边缘网络；同时实际移动感知中测量稀疏且分布不均，带来估计不确定性，而该不确定性对指导RME与节点协作至关重要，现有方法未充分利用。

Method: 每个节点基于本地稀疏测量推断概率模型，同时估计本地无线电地图及其估计不确定性；邻居节点间不交换原始数据或模型更新，仅交换重叠监测区域上的低维统计量（无线电地图与不确定性度量）；设计不确定性感知统计共识机制，通过保证估计置信度一致性来迭代对齐邻域内的概率模型；并进行收敛性与分布式泛化性能的理论分析。

Result: 理论分析证明了所提共识机制的收敛性，并刻画了UA-D-RME的分布式泛化性能；在城市无线电地图数据集上的实验表明，UA-D-RME在重构精度上可与集中式RME基准相当，同时降低通信成本，且无需交换原始测量数据。

Conclusion: UA-D-RME为去中心化网络提供了一种通信高效的无线电地图估计方案，通过低维统计信息交换与不确定性驱动的共识机制，在保护原始数据的同时取得与集中式基准相当的重构精度。

Abstract: Federated learning based radio map estimation (RME) approaches rely on frequent exchange of high-dimensional model updates and often require a central server for collaboration coordination and update aggregation. This incurs prohibitively high communication overhead, rendering them impractical for bandwidth-constrained mobile and wireless edge networks. Moreover, in practical mobile sensing scenarios, sparse and unevenly collected measurements lead to estimation uncertainty, which is critical for guiding RME and collaboration among distributed nodes. To address these challenges, this paper proposes an uncertainty-aware distributed radio map estimation (UA-D-RME) framework for decentralized networks. In UA-D-RME, each node locally infers a probabilistic model from its sparse measurements to estimate both its local radio map and the associated estimation uncertainty. Instead of exchanging raw data or model updates, neighboring nodes communicate only low-dimensional statistical information, including radio map and uncertainty measures over their overlapping monitoring areas. An uncertainty-aware statistical consensus mechanism is then developed to iteratively align probabilistic models in neighborhood by ensuring consistency on estimation confidence. Theoretical analysis establishes the convergence of the proposed consensus mechanism and characterizes the distributed generalization performance of the proposed UA-D-RME method. Experiments on urban radio map datasets verify that UA-D-RME achieves desired reconstruction accuracy comparable to the centralized RME benchmark while reducing communication costs and without exchanging raw measurements.

</details>


### [288] [Stabilizing Filters for Graph Signal Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28318)
*Martin Schmidt,Gonzalo Mateos*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文研究融合图滤波与图神经网络的连续时间生成模型的结构稳定性，推导图扰动对生成分布影响的Wasserstein稳定性界，据此提出兼顾结构稳定性与信号平滑的图滤波器设计框架，并给出具有可证稳定性的多项式滤波器族；合成图与真实fMRI实验验证理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图信号生成需将底层图结构纳入生成模型以实现结构感知的分布建模，但实际图常含噪声或估计不准确。已有工作仅给出图神经ODE的稳定性保证，而拓扑薛定谔桥等模型中"图感知参考动力学"的鲁棒性尚缺乏研究，结构误差可能扭曲生成过程与所得信号分布。

Method: 针对动力学由"图滤波器+学习型图神经网络"组合构成的连续时间生成模型，推导量化图扰动对生成信号分布影响的Wasserstein稳定性界；以该分析为指导，提出图滤波器设计原则，在结构稳定性与诱导的信号平滑之间进行权衡；刻画最优滤波器设计，并构造显式的多项式滤波器族，证明其稳定性保证。

Result: 理论分析给出了显式的Wasserstein稳定性界及最优滤波器刻画与可证保证的多项式滤波器族；在合成图与真实fMRI信号上的实验支持理论结论，表明所提滤波器在保持生成性能的同时增强了结构稳定性。

Conclusion: 图感知参考动力学的结构稳定性可通过滤波器设计加以显式控制；所提框架为含噪声图下的连续时间图生成模型提供了可证鲁棒的滤波器设计准则，并兼具实用性与理论保证。

Abstract: Generating graph signals is an important task in machine learning, and incorporating the underlying graph into a generative model enables structurally-informed distribution modeling. However, said graph is often noisy or imperfectly estimated, and structural errors can affect the generative process and the resulting signal distribution. While recent work has established stability guarantees for graph neural ordinary differential equations, the robustness of graph-aware reference dynamics, as used in topological Schrödinger bridge models, remains largely unexplored. Here, we investigate the structural stability of continuous-time generative models whose dynamics combine a graph filter with a learned graph neural network. We first derive a Wasserstein stability bound that quantifies the effect of graph perturbations on the generated signal distributions. Informed by this analysis, we then propose a principled framework for designing graph filters that balance structural stability with induced signal smoothing. We characterize the optimal filter design and provide an explicit family of polynomial filters with provable stability guarantees. Experiments on synthetic graphs and real-world fMRI signals support our theoretical findings, illustrating the enhanced structural stability of the proposed filters while preserving generative performance.

</details>


### [289] [Finite-Size CV-QKD for Satellite Quantum Communication under a Hybrid Noise Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28353)
*Mouli Chakraborty,Avishek Nag,Subhash Chandra,Anshu Mukherjee,Konstantinos Koufos,Mehrdad Dianati*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出卫星连续变量量子密钥分发（CV-QKD）有限码长框架，统一混合噪声模型，导出严格随码块长度递减的单一安全密钥率表达式，并量化有限码长对可行性的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卫星CV-QKD受有限通信窗口、信道衰减与有限量子态数目带来的统计涨落制约；以往处理中分段式与码块级有限码长修正表述不一致，且QBER与可行性约束缺乏同等的块长依赖，需要统一刻画。

Method: 构建联合混合噪声模型（卫星几何、大气与传播损耗、量子泊松噪声与经典AWGN共存、探测器非理想），在集体攻击下采用可组合有限密钥安全性；推导单一规范有限码长SKR表达式，修正项对块长严格单调递减；通过显式参数估计惩罚把有限码长计入QBER，使可行性约束继承相同块长依赖；数值扫描和解效率、传输/探测效率、接收孔径、束腰、天顶角、波长与有效通信时间。

Result: 有限码长与渐近运行间存在显著性能差距，渐近分析可将可行卫星高度高估数倍；可达距离主要由实际交换的信号数（块长）决定，而非任何单一物理信道参数。

Conclusion: 块长应被视为卫星CV-QKD任务设计的首要设计变量；所提统一有限码长框架为卫星CV-QKD的链路预算与任务维度规划提供了自洽基准。

Abstract: Satellite-based continuous-variable quantum key distribution (CV-QKD) is fundamentally constrained by finite communication windows, channel attenuation, and statistical fluctuations arising from a limited number of exchanged quantum states. This work develops a finite-size CV-QKD framework for satellite quantum communication under a hybrid noise model that jointly incorporates satellite geometry, atmospheric and propagation losses, quantum Poissonian noise coexisting with classical additive white Gaussian noise, detector imperfections, and composable finite-key security under collective attacks. A single canonical finite-size secret key rate (SKR) expression is derived in which the finite-size correction is stated in a strictly decreasing form in the block size, removing the ambiguity between the segmented and the block-level formulations used in earlier treatments. The finite-size accounting is further extended to the quantum bit error ratio (QBER) through an explicit parameter estimation penalty, so that the feasibility constraint inherits the same block-size dependence as the key rate. The framework quantifies the influence of reconciliation efficiency, transmission efficiency, detection efficiency, receiver aperture, beam waist, zenith angle, wavelength, and effective communication time. Numerical results reveal a significant performance gap between finite-size and asymptotic operation, indicating that asymptotic analysis can overestimate the feasible satellite altitude by a factor of several, and that the achievable range is governed by the number of signals actually exchanged rather than by any single physical channel parameter. These results establish block size as a first-class design variable for satellite CV-QKD mission dimensioning.

</details>


### [290] [Topology-Adaptive Seismic Response Prediction of Interconnected Structural Systems Using Reduced Order Model Embedded Graph Neural Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28378)
*Huangbin Liang,Beatriz Moya,Francisco Chinesta,Eleni Chatzi*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出ROMeGNN方法，将降阶模型嵌入图神经网络，用GNN学习拓扑相关的耦合力并驱动可微模态求解器，实现互连变电站设备的拓扑自适应地震数字孪生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 互连变电站设备（母线、软导线连接）存在复杂动力相互作用，受局部结构特性、机械耦合、系统拓扑与瞬态激励共同影响。高保真有限元模型计算昂贵，难以实时预测；纯数据驱动模型推理快但泛化差，每遇新构型需重新仿真与训练。

Method: 将系统建模为图：结构构件为节点、机械互连为边。每个高保真构件模型先降阶为模态表示，构成GNN内部的可微动力学算子。GNN不直接学习完整响应，而是估计拓扑依赖的相互作用力，作为耦合输入进入可微ROM求解器以推进模态状态；该混合框架保留已知构件级物理，并通过消息传递学习跨布局的复杂构件间作用力。

Result: 在随机地震输入下的互连变电站设备上验证，可快速预测与地震损伤评估相关的响应量，且适用于不同布局、构件组合与激励场景。

Conclusion: 将物理嵌入图学习架构，可实现实时、可解释、拓扑自适应的互连工程系统地震数字孪生。

Abstract: Electrical substation equipment is commonly interconnected by busbars and flexible conductors. Such interconnected infrastructures exhibit complex dynamic interactions, where the response of each component is influenced by local structural properties, mechanical coupling, system topology, and transient excitation. High-fidelity FE models can capture some of these effects, but their computational cost limits their use for real-time prediction. Purely data-driven models offer faster inference, yet they struggle to generalize, requiring additional simulations and retraining for each new configuration. This work presents a ROM embedded Graph Neural Network (ROMeGNN) for topology-aware seismic digital twins of interconnected structural systems. The system is represented as a graph, where structural components are treated as nodes and mechanical interconnections as edges. Each high-fidelity component model is first reduced to a reduced-order modal representation, which forms a differentiable dynamics operator within the GNN. Rather than learning the full response directly, the GNN estimates topology-dependent interaction forces that enter the differentiable ROM solver as coupling inputs for modal state advancement. This hybrid formulation preserves the known component-level physics and uses data-driven message passing to learn complex inter-component forces across varying system layouts. The framework is demonstrated on interconnected electrical substation equipment subjected to randomized seismic inputs. It delivers rapid predictions of response quantities relevant to seismic damage assessment while remaining applicable across varying layouts, component combinations, and excitation scenarios. These results highlight the potential of embedding physics within graph learning architectures for real-time, interpretable, topology-adaptive seismic digital twins of interconnected engineering systems.

</details>


### [291] [ORCA: Onboard Reflective Collaborative Agents for Reliable Task Offloading in LEO Satellite Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28404)
*Yunxin Geng,Shengxiang Hao,Yichen Wu,Haotian Liu,Weiwei Jiang,Lu Cao,Han Meng,Yuxuan Pan,Zhiqing Wei*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: ORCA提出一种四智能体"感知→推理→行动→学习"闭环的星载反射式协作卸载架构，在异构、链路动态且邻居不确定的低轨卫星网络中实现去中心化任务卸载，并在仿真中表现出更强的任务成功鲁棒性与卸载可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低轨卫星越来越多承担时延敏感的在轨处理任务，但异构算力、快速变化的星间链路与不确定的邻居行为，使部分可观测条件下的去中心化任务卸载十分困难。

Method: 提出ORCA架构，将卸载决策组织为Perceive→Reason→Act→Learn四智能体闭环；各智能体分工完成环境感知、决策推理、卸载执行与结果反馈学习，并以结果导向的"反射"机制在运行时无需集中协调地自我修正策略。

Result: 在60颗卫星的异构Walker-delta星座仿真中，ORCA在协作场景下系统效率具有竞争力；在未见过的恶意节点行为下，任务成功率鲁棒性与卸载可靠性更优。

Conclusion: 结果导向的反射机制可在无集中式运行时协调的前提下提升去中心化星载卸载的可靠性。

Abstract: Low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites increasingly perform time-critical onboard processing, yet heterogeneous computing capabilities, rapidly changing inter-satellite links (ISLs) and uncertain neighbor behavior make decentralized task offloading difficult under partial observations. This paper presents ORCA, an architecture of Onboard Reflective Collaborative Agents for autonomous onboard task offloading. ORCA organizes offloading decisions into a four-Agent \emph{Perceive}$\rightarrow$\emph{Reason}$\rightarrow$ \emph{Act}$\rightarrow$\emph{Learn} loop. It aims to improve efficiency and reliability in dynamic, heterogeneous, and unreliable LEO satellite networks. The simulation results of a heterogeneous 60-satellite Walker-delta constellation demonstrates that ORCA delivers competitive system efficiency in cooperative settings while achieving superior task-success robustness and offloading reliability under previously unseen malicious node behavior, indicating that outcome-grounded reflection can improve the reliability of decentralized onboard offloading without centralized runtime coordination.

</details>


### [292] [How Much of Cross-Subject EEG Emotion Recognition Is Stimulus Memorization?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28422)
*Haiyan Xu,Konstantinos N. Plataniotis*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 论文指出跨被试EEG情绪识别中一个被忽略的捷径：情绪标签在设计阶段被赋予视频，任何能恢复"所观看视频"的编码器即可免费获得标签。作者将三种表征级捷径诊断用于已发表的对比学习跨被试编码器，发现刺激身份以随机水平6–15倍的线性可解码性存在；联合留出被试与刺激后，各已发布分类器在被试独立但视频未见条件下准确率下降2–44个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前跨被试EEG情绪识别在SEED等刺激定义基准上报告>90%准确率，领域已讨论被试身份、数据划分、重复刺激呈现等导致虚高的因素，但遗漏了"刺激身份"这一变量：标签在实验设计时绑定于视频，编码器只要识别出所看视频即可"免费"得到标签，从而把情绪解码任务退化为刺激识别任务，使被试留出下的高指标不能代表跨被试情绪解码能力。

Method: 1) 将三种表征级捷径诊断（shortcut diagnostics）适配到一组已发表的对比学习跨被试编码器上，检验刺激身份是否可从隐表征中线性恢复；2) 以随机水平为基线量化线性可恢复倍数；3) 在评估中联合留出被试与刺激（subject + stimulus hold-out），比较被试单独留出与刺激未见条件下的准确率落差。

Result: 刺激身份在编码器表征中可线性恢复，强度达随机水平的6–15倍；在被试与刺激联合留出下，每个已发布分类器准确率下降2–44个百分点，表明被试留出单独获得的高分并非跨被试情绪解码的度量。

Conclusion: 刺激身份是跨被试EEG情绪识别中被忽视的严重捷径，可系统性夸大报告精度。建议基准评估采用被试与刺激联合留出，并报告表征级捷径诊断，以区分真正的情绪解码能力与刺激识别能力。

Abstract: Cross-subject EEG emotion recognition now reports accuracies above 90% on stimulus-defined benchmarks such as SEED, and the field has examined several ways in which such numbers can be inflated, attributing inflation to subject identity, to data partitioning, and to repeated stimulus presentation. We observe that one variable has been left out. On these datasets the emotion label is assigned to the video at design time, so any encoder that recovers which video was shown obtains the label for free. We adapt three representation-level shortcut diagnostics to a cohort of published contrastive cross-subject encoders, and find that stimulus identity is linearly recoverable at six to fifteen times chance. We then measure its impact on the reported accuracy by holding out subjects and stimuli jointly, and find that each released classifier loses two to forty-four points once the test videos are unseen, so a headline obtained under subject hold-out alone is not a measure of cross-subject emotion decoding.

</details>


### [293] [A Hierarchical Space-Ground Collaborative Network: Architecture Design and Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28459)
*Yunxin Geng,Shaopeng Feng,Zijian Guo,Shengfeng Wang,Rui Ding,Kan Zheng,Zhiqing Wei,Weiwei Jiang,Zhiyong Feng*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该论文面向6G星地一体化网络（SGIN），提出分层星地协同网络（SGCN）架构及业务感知的弹性部署策略，以应对LEO信道强时空非平稳性与海量异构业务需求波动，并通过三个递进基线场景完成评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G要求卫星与地面段融合形成泛在全局连接，但传统独立管理范式难以应对低轨信道深刻的时空非平稳性以及海量异构业务的高动态需求，亟需架构层面的重构与适配异构业务的弹性部署方法。

Method: 先梳理SGIN发展趋势，将典型应用场景归纳为两大类并分析其挑战与约束；进而提出分层星地协同网络（SGCN）架构，以提升网络容量、广域连续覆盖与频谱效率；随后引入业务感知的部署策略以增强架构的工程可行性，并设置三个代表性场景与递进式基线进行对比评估。

Result: 所提SGCN架构在三个代表性场景中相对递进基线实现了更大的网络能力、广泛的连续覆盖以及更高的频谱效率；业务感知部署策略进一步验证了架构的工程可实现性。

Conclusion: 分层星地协同架构结合业务感知弹性部署，可作为6G星地一体化网络应对信道非平稳性与异构业务波动的可行技术路径。

Abstract: The sixth-generation (6G) landscape demands a profound architectural evolution toward a unified, collaborative ecosystem that integrates satellite and terrestrial segments to provide ubiquitous global connectivity. Nevertheless, conventional independent management paradigms are increasingly challenged by the profound spatiotemporal nonstationarity of low-Earth orbit (LEO) channels and the volatile demands of massive heterogeneous services. To address these challenges, this study focuses on the architectural design of space-ground integrated networks (SGINs) and investigates elastic deployment strategies tailored to heterogeneous 6G service requirements. We first review the development trends in SGIN and then summarize typical application scenarios into two categories, along with their associated challenges and constraints. After that, a hierarchical space-ground collaborative network (SGCN) architecture is proposed to support achieving larger network capability, extensive continuous coverage, and enhanced spectral efficiency, which is evaluated through three representative scenarios with progressive baselines. Subsequently, a service-aware deployment strategy is introduced to further establish the engineering feasibility of the proposed architecture.

</details>


### [294] [Delayed Convergence of S-Parameter Sensitivities to Design Parameters in FDTD Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28496)
*Byungkwan Kim*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: FDTD中S参数灵敏度因截断收敛比S参数慢；单模误差为(1+T/τ)e^{-T/τ}，1%误差需T≥6.6τ而非4.6τ；自动微分/离散伴随/有限差分同源误差无法自检；矩阵束外推可将仿真时长缩短66倍；截断会移动多极点优化最优解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FDTD中基于DFT的S参数灵敏度在仿真时间T截断时存在误差；研究者常以自动微分、离散伴随与有限差分的相互一致来验证梯度，但这些方法共享同一截断误差，无法揭示问题。需要定量刻画灵敏度的收敛行为及其对优化的影响。

Method: 推导单模场衰减时间τ下的截断误差解析式：灵敏度为(1+T/τ)e^{-T/τ}，S参数谐振部分为e^{-T/τ}；在三个求解器中无拟合参数地验证该估计；构造慢模弱耦合腔体测试常用终止准则；在可微计算中引入矩阵束外推；用单极点与双极点滤波器回路分析截断对优化最优点的偏移。

Result: 估计式在Q=1000–7000的腔谐振处将仿真误差预测至4%以内，低Q时误差更大；弱耦合慢模腔中|S11|在1.3 dB凹陷的0.5 dB内但灵敏度误差达10–72%；矩阵束外推使带场探针的仿真缩短66倍仍恢复灵敏度；单极点对称目标下最优点不动，双极点时1τ运行过耦合Δk≈1.24/Q，3τ下等波纹目标仍偏移约0.2ᾱ，4.6τ时不再偏移。

Conclusion: FDTD灵敏度收敛显著慢于S参数，同源梯度验证不可靠；应以6.6τ等更严格准则设定仿真时长，或用矩阵束外推在可微框架内加速收敛；截断误差在单极点场景可能被对称性掩盖，但在多极点耦合优化中会系统性偏移最优解。

Abstract: In the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method, the sensitivities of S-parameters to design parameters come from discrete Fourier transforms of responses ending at a simulation time T. We show that, when a design parameter moves a resonance, the sensitivity converges later than the S-parameter. For a single mode with field decay time $τ$, the truncation error of the sensitivity is $(1+T/τ)e^{-T/τ}$, against $e^{-T/τ}$ for the resonant part of the S-parameter, so a 1% sensitivity error needs $T \geq 6.6τ$ instead of $4.6τ$. Automatic differentiation, the discrete adjoint and finite differences on the same run carry this error, so their agreement cannot reveal it. In three solvers, with no fitted parameter, the estimate predicts the simulated error within 4% at cavity resonances with $Q$ of 1000-7000; at lower $Q$ the error is larger. On a cavity whose slowest mode is weakly coupled, common end criteria leave $|S_{11}|$ within 0.5 dB of a 1.3 dB dip but its sensitivity 10-72% in error. A matrix-pencil extrapolation inside the differentiable computation recovers the sensitivity on a cavity with field probes from a run 66 times shorter. In a single-pole filter loop with a symmetric objective, truncation leaves the maximum of the objective in place, and the optimizer reaches the resonance of a full run despite the wrong gradient. With two coupled poles, the truncated objective moves the optimum: on runs of $1τ$ it over-couples by $Δk \approx 1.24/Q$, and an equal-ripple objective still shifts it by about $0.2\barα$ at $3τ$, but not at $4.6τ$.

</details>


### [295] [Beamfocusing Versus Airy Beams: Does Antenna Blockage Require Beam Bending?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28557)
*Emil Björnson,Vitaly Petrov,Erik G. Larsson*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文证明在内生障碍遮挡场景下，传统波束聚焦（beamfocusing）对接收功率最大化是最优的，Airy 波束"绕过障碍"的弯曲轨迹并不能带来接收功率增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Airy 波束被广泛提出用于阵列波束成形，以"绕过"障碍物实现非视距区域覆盖。但作者质疑：无论天线是否被遮挡、信道状态信息是否存在相位误差，真正最大化接收功率的预编码是否必须是 Airy 波束，还是传统波束聚焦本身已最优。

Method: 理论分析：对单天线接收机证明波束聚焦在任意数量天线被遮挡、以及 CSI 存在相位误差的期望情形下均最大化接收功率；对多天线接收机，在秩一信道满足的"相位可分离"条件下给出同样的最优性结论。并用数值仿真在不同接收机物理尺寸与障碍物配置下比较波束聚焦与 Airy 波束。

Result: 理论上，单天线接收机与传统波束聚焦最优性成立；秩一信道下多天线接收机同样成立。数值上，当接收机物理尺寸较小（落在波束宽度内）且有障碍时，未修改的波束聚焦即最优；当接收机较大时，最优预编码偏离波束聚焦以更好照射未遮挡部分，但不会退化为 Airy 波束。Airy 波束可被配置为性能良好，但其弯曲轨迹并不最大化障碍后方的接收功率。

Conclusion: "Airy 波束绕过障碍"的直觉并不等价于接收功率最优。常规波束聚焦在小尺寸接收机与秩一信道下已被证明最优；对更大接收机应针对未遮挡区域设计预编码，而非依赖 Airy 波束。

Abstract: Airy beams are often proposed in array beamforming to bend beams around obstacles. We prove that, for a single-antenna receiver, conventional beamfocusing maximizes the received power regardless of how many antennas are blocked and, in expectation, even with phase errors in the channel state information. This also holds for multi-antenna receivers under a phase-separability condition that is satisfied in rank-one channels. Numerical results confirm that unmodified beamfocusing is optimal for physically small receivers (i.e., those that fit within the beamwidth) when an obstacle is present. For physically larger receivers, the optimal precoding deviates from beamfocusing to better illuminate the receiver's unobstructed parts, but will not become Airy beams. While Airy beams can be configured to perform well, their ability to follow a bent trajectory in front of an obstacle does not maximize the received power behind it.

</details>

### [296] [Enhancing analytical photon transport in turbid media through physics-guided neural network corrections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26917)
*Guojun Tang,Paul D. Teal,Alexander Doronin*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出物理引导的残差学习框架，将扩散近似（DA）解析预测作为物理先验，神经网络只学习其与Monte Carlo参考之间的残差，从而兼顾解析法的计算效率与MC的精度，并显著提升数据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解析法计算高效但受近似假设限制、精度不足；MC模拟精度高（"金标准"）但计算代价大，难以用于需反复前向评估的实时与反问题场景。作者希望结合两者的优势。

Method: 以扩散近似为代表性案例：输入吸收系数、散射系数与各向异性因子，先由DA给出解析预测作为物理先验，再训练神经网络仅拟合DA预测与MC参考之间的残差；DA在强吸收、弱散射及边界处理不完善时存在系统性偏差，正是残差学习的目标。

Result: 在所评估的光学参数范围内，标量反射率RMSE与空间分辨反射率RMSLE分别较DA降低约62倍和14倍；仅用1%的训练数据时，相应误差比直接神经网络代理模型低约87%和93%。

Conclusion: 对解析物理基线学习修正量可同时提升预测精度与数据效率，为浑浊介质光传输建模提供了一种高效高精度的混合方案。

Abstract: Analytical methods provide rapid and computationally efficient predictions of light transport in turbid media, making them attractive for real-time and inverse applications. However, their accuracy is limited by the approximations and assumptions used to obtain tractable solutions. On the other hand, Monte Carlo (MC) simulation is widely regarded as the "gold standard" for modeling light transport in turbid media, but its high computational cost limits its use in applications requiring repeated forward evaluations. Here, we introduce a physics-guided residual learning framework that combines the computational efficiency of analytical modeling with the accuracy of MC simulation. As a representative case study, we consider the diffusion approximation (DA), which can exhibit systematic errors under relatively strong absorption, weak scattering, and imperfect boundary treatment. Given the absorption coefficient, scattering coefficient, and anisotropy factor, the corresponding DA prediction is incorporated as a physical prior, while the network learns only the residual between the analytical prediction and the MC reference. Across the evaluated optical-property range, the proposed framework reduces scalar-reflectance RMSE and spatially resolved reflectance RMSLE by factors of approximately 62 and 14, respectively, relative to the diffusion approximation. With only 1\% of the available training data, it achieves approximately 87\% and 93\% lower corresponding errors than a direct neural-network surrogate. These results demonstrate that learning corrections to an analytical physical baseline improves both prediction accuracy and data efficiency.

</details>


### [297] [Gerchberg-Saxton Optimized Silicon Metasurface for Sinusoidal Structured-Light Three-Dimensional Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26956)
*Gengyuan Ye,Shuming Wang*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一种基于硅介质超表面（940 nm）的紧凑型结构光3D成像平台，利用GS相位优化将正弦条纹编码到超表面纳米柱几何中，并结合四步相移法重建三维形貌。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统结构光系统依赖数字微镜器件（DMD）、衍射光学元件等笨重投影组件，制约了系统的小型化与集成化，亟需紧凑可扩展的结构光投影方案。

Method: 设计工作于940 nm近红外的硅介质超表面；采用Gerchberg-Saxton（GS）相位优化算法将目标远场正弦条纹分布转换为纳米级相位剖面，再映射为硅纳米柱结构；将制备的超表面与四步相移重建算法结合，实现三维物体轮廓恢复。

Result: 制备的超表面可产生高质量正弦结构光照明，并与四步相移重建流程集成，成功恢复物体三维轮廓。

Conclusion: 该方案为小型化结构光投影与光学三维传感提供了紧凑、可扩展的解决途径。

Abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) optical imaging based on structured illumination has attracted considerable attention in applications including machine vision, robotics, and computational sensing. However, conventional structured-light systems generally rely on bulky projection components, such as digital micromirror devices and diffractive optical elements, which limit system miniaturization and integration. Here, we demonstrate a compact structured-light 3D imaging platform enabled by a silicon dielectric metasurface operating at a near-infrared wavelength of 940 nm. The desired sinusoidal fringe illumination is encoded into the metasurface through a Gerchberg-Saxton (GS) phase optimization algorithm, which converts the target far-field distribution into a nanoscale phase profile and subsequently into silicon nanopillar geometries. The fabricated metasurface generates high-quality sinusoidal structured illumination, which is integrated with a four-step phase-shifting reconstruction method to recover 3D object profiles. The proposed approach provides a compact and scalable solution for miniaturized structured-light projection and optical 3D sensing.

</details>


### [298] [Shaping the spectra of second harmonic laser by spatial focusing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27011)
*Yan-Ming Liu,Tao Xie,Xiangying Hao,Rui-Bo Jin*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出理论模型描述泵浦聚焦条件对SHG光谱展宽的影响，并用BBO晶体与50 mm、200 mm焦距透镜实验验证，给出通过聚焦工程化SHG谱宽的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SHG谱宽在非线性显微、超快光谱与量子光学中需精确调控；已知聚焦透镜焦距影响SHG光谱，但缺乏简单而精确的理论解释。

Method: 建立理论模型描述泵浦聚焦条件对SHG光谱展宽的规律；在BBO晶体中分别用焦距50 mm与200 mm的透镜进行实验验证。

Result: 理论模型与两组焦距下的实验测量结果一致（摘要未给出具体数值），说明可通过泵浦聚焦调控SHG谱宽。

Conclusion: 确立了通过泵浦聚焦工程化SHG谱宽的实用方法，为具有特定光谱需求的非线性光学系统设计提供指导。

Abstract: Accurately controlling the spectral width of second harmonic generation (SHG) is critical in applications such as nonlinear microscopy, ultrafast spectroscopy, and quantum optics, where tailored spectral properties are required. Although it is known that the focal length of the lens used to focus the pump beam influences the SHG spectrum, a simple and precise theoretical understanding of this effect has been lacking. Here, we develop a theoretical model to describe how pump focusing conditions affect SHG spectral broadening, and experimentally validate the model using BBO crystals with lenses of 50 mm and 200 mm focal lengths. Our results establish a practical method for engineering the SHG spectral width through pump focusing, providing valuable guidance for designing nonlinear optical systems with specific spectral requirements.

</details>


### [299] [Allight: A Perfect Photon Collector](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27161)
*Dan Porat,Ran Finkelstein,Tal Carmon*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文提出一种通过逆向设计包裹发光体的环绕式介质结构实现的"完美光收集器"，可将全4π立体角的发射光子收集并准直输出，理论收集效率趋近于1，并在二维实验中验证了全向发射的准直偏折。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光与物质相互作用中，光子收集效率受限于传统透镜只能从单一方向收集光，制约了量子发射体的应用效率。

Method: 将器件分解为若干折射界面，对包裹发射体的介质结构进行逆向设计，实现从全4π立体角收集发射光并经绝热整形转化为准直光束；采用二维实验验证使全向发射准直的射线弯曲效应。

Result: 理论收集效率可趋近于1；二维实验成功演示了将全向发射准直的射线弯曲；所得器件为宽带、非共振的介质结构，具备实验鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该收集器将当前基于窄带、腔增强的高效光子收集范式，转变为宽带、非共振、实验稳健的介质器件方案。

Abstract: Collecting photons from quantum emitters remains a key limitation in light-matter interaction because conventional lenses collect light only from one direction. Here, we introduce a perfect light collector by inverse-designing a surrounding dielectric structure that encloses the emitter to increase photon-collection efficiency toward unity. Decomposing the device into several refractive interfaces enables emission collection from the full 4$π$ solid angle with adiabatic reshaping into a collimated beam. We experimentally demonstrate, in two dimensions, the ray bending that collimates omnidirectional emission. Our collector transforms current paradigms for highly efficient photon collection from narrowband, cavity-based techniques into experimentally robust, broadband, non-resonant dielectric devices.

</details>


### [300] [Controlling Optical Quantum Interference with Plasmonic Metasurfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27226)
*Lawrence M. Qin,Sky Semone,Matthew J. Brandsema,Christos Argyropoulos*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文提出一种复合量子等离激元超表面，作为超薄非幺正分束器，仅通过改变入射光子频率或设计尺寸即可在同一器件上实现单光子玻色聚束与费米反聚束干涉，并用"量子聚结度"指标定量刻画该干涉效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用同一器件高效调控光学量子干涉是量子信息处理中的难题，而现有方案难以在单一超薄平台上同时实现玻色聚束与反聚束两类干涉，亟需可调、集成化的量子干涉调控手段。

Method: 构建复合等离激元超表面：底层为周期性纳米狭缝波纹的等离激元光栅以实现异常光透射，其上叠加纳米条带形成纳米腔，产生局域间隙等离激元共振；通过改变入射光子频率或器件设计尺寸调节工作模式，并以量子聚结度（quantum coalescence metric）计算光子-光子相互作用来表征干涉结果。

Result: 该超表面可在超薄结构下表现为非幺正分束器，实现单光子玻色聚束与费米型反聚束干涉的可控切换；量子聚结度计算准确再现了所获得的聚束/反聚束量子干涉特性。

Conclusion: 该量子干涉操作既适用于基础的非经典光相互作用研究，也可用于设计面向量子计算与量子通信的实用化量子光学逻辑门。

Abstract: The ability to efficiently control optical quantum interference by the same device is a challenging task that promises to enable key operations in quantum information processing. Here, we tackle this problem by presenting a composite quantum plasmonic metasurface operating as an ultrathin non-unitary beamsplitter capable of achieving both single photon bosonic bunching and fermionic anti-bunching interference just by varying the incident photons frequency or changing the design dimensions. The presented metasurface combines a plasmonic grating corrugated by periodic nanoslits that can achieve extraordinary optical transmission with additional nanostripes on top forming nanocavities characterized by localized gap plasmon resonances. The photon-photon interactions are analyzed based on calculating the quantum coalescence metric which accurately portrays the obtained bunching or anti-bunching quantum interference. The presented quantum interference operation is applicable to both fundamental non-classical light interactions and in the design of more applied quantum optical logic gates used in quantum computing and communications.

</details>


### [301] [The optical force on a dielectric slab](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27254)
*Andrew Laeuger,Kevin Kuns,Yanbei Chen,Nancy Aggarwal*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 论文计算浸没在介质流体中、厚度任意的无损介质板所受的辐射压力力，指出仅用外部场动量通量会遗漏板内存储的电磁动量的时间变化；该存储项在低频下约化为 (L_s/c^2)dP/dt，并在腔中产生速度相关力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通常由外部场动量通量计算透射光学器件的辐射压力与动力学反作用，但对有限厚度介质板会忽略其内部存储电磁动量的时间依赖，可能导致力计算不完整或与洛伦兹力结果不一致。

Method: 对浸没于介电液体中的无损介质板（厚度 L_s 任意）分别用束缚电荷所受洛伦兹力与外部动量通量两种方法计算力，处理任意载波与边带场；周围介质以给定的线性介电响应描述，不建模流体的机械响应（压强、电致伸缩）。

Result: 两种方法在薄反射镜极限下给出相同的预期力，但在一般情形下相差板内存储场动量的变化率；该存储项在静态场下为零，低频下约化为 (L_s/c^2)dP/dt（P 为净透射功率）；在腔中 P 随板位置变化，故存储项产生速度相关力。对外部真空环境，Abraham 与 Minkowski 动量表述在存储项上可协调一致，给出介质所受的无歧义力。

Conclusion: 计算透射介质板辐射压力时必须计入板内存储电磁动量的时间变化率；该项导致腔内速度相关力，并在真空环境下使 Abraham/Minkowski 表述对介质净力达成一致。

Abstract: Radiation-pressure forces on transmissive optics, including dynamical backaction, are usually computed from the momentum flux of the external fields. For a dielectric of finite thickness, this omits the time dependence of the electromagnetic momentum stored inside. We compute the force on a lossless dielectric slab of arbitrary thickness $L_s$ submerged in a dielectric fluid, proceeding from both Lorentz force on its bound charges and from the external momentum fluxes for arbitrary carrier and sideband fields. We treat the surrounding medium through a prescribed linear dielectric response and do not model the accompanying mechanical response of the fluid, including pressure and electrostriction. These two methods both recover the expected force in the limit of a thin reflector, but differ in the more general case by the rate of change of the field momentum stored in the slab. This storage term vanishes for static fields and at low frequencies reduces to $(L_s/c^2)\,dP/dt$, where $P$ is the net power through the slab. In a cavity, where $P$ depends on the slab position, the storage term produces a velocity-dependent force. The Abraham and Minkowski momentum formulations applied to the storage term are reconciled to give an unambiguous force on the dielectric in the case of an exterior vacuum environment, where there is no fluid response to model.

</details>


### [302] [Nanophotonic Extreme Ultraviolet Polarimeter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27705)
*Anna Kulter,Lorenz Weiß,David J. Grafinger,Alexander Sagar Grossek,Rodolfo Previdi,Martin Schultze,Marcus Ossiander*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文利用通道波导中两个本征模式的传播长度依赖干涉实现偏振依赖的前向散射，制成首个透过式极紫外（41 nm）纳米光子偏振分析器，单次测量即可解析偏振轴与光谱，偏振旋转灵敏度达0.9°（1 s测量）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纳米光子学已能操控可见光偏振，但极紫外（EUV）波段（阿秒科学与半导体光刻所在谱区）缺乏透射式光学元件，偏振操控手段空缺，亟需可透射、紧凑的EUV偏振调控与分析器件。

Method: 设计通道波导，将41 nm入射光限制在少数具有确定空间分布与传播常数的模式中；通过设计两种本征模式随传播长度的干涉，实现偏振依赖的前向散射；据此构建透过式纳米光子分析器，单次测量解析EUV光的偏振轴与光谱。

Result: 实现偏振分辨的透过式EUV分析器：1秒测量下偏振旋转灵敏度0.9°，具备单发（single-shot）测量能力，可在一次测量中同时获得偏振轴与光谱信息。

Conclusion: 该工作将纳米光子偏振调控拓展至极紫外波段，为超快磁光光谱学及基于加速器的光源实验提供新手段。

Abstract: Nanophotonic engineering has revolutionized how we manipulate the polarization of visible light. Here, we extend such control to extreme ultraviolet radiation, the spectral region of attosecond science and semiconductor lithography, where transmissive optical elements are lacking. We implement channel waveguides that restrict incident 41-nm-wavelength light to a few modes with defined spatial profiles and propagation constants. By designing the propagation-length-dependent interference of two eigenmodes, we achieve polarization-dependent forward scattering, which we exploit to create a transmissive nanophotonic analyzer that resolves the polarization axis and spectrum of extreme ultraviolet light from a single measurement. With a 0.9°-sensitivity for polarization rotations in a 1-second measurement and single-shot capability, the device opens new experimental opportunities in ultrafast magneto-optic spectroscopy and at accelerator-based light sources.

</details>


### [303] [Continuously Tunable Mid-Infrared Metalens Integrating Moiré and Pancharatnam-Berry Phases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28389)
*Keivan Kaboutari,Muchuan Chen,Xiu Liu,Sheng Shen,Pedro Pinho,Stanislav Maslovski*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一种中红外变焦超透镜，融合PB相位与Moiré图案机制，通过旋转双层Ge纳米结构盘实现连续焦距调控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中红外波段缺乏紧凑、可连续变焦的光学元件，需要将无机械移动的旋转式波前调控集成到超透镜中以实现小型化变焦成像。

Method: 采用两片相同结构盘（CaF2衬底上Ge纳米柱），以双折射半波片形式工作，将PB相位与Moiré图案旋转相位结合；2 μm波长下实现99.95%偏振转换率与83.65%总透射率，并用全波数值仿真验证旋转第二片（30°–120°）的聚焦性能。

Result: 焦距由45 μm连续调至12 μm，数值孔径相应从22.99%增至68.67%；对任意入射偏振均可重构聚焦，同时在RCP与LCP照明下产生相反的相位响应，实现偏振选择性控制。

Conclusion: 该双层旋转式超透镜在中红外实现了连续、可重构且偏振可控的变焦聚焦，为紧凑型主动变焦光学系统提供了可行方案。

Abstract: A varifocal mid-infrared metalens designed for focusing applications is proposed to integrate both Pancharatnam-Berry (PB) and Moiré pattern-based mechanisms for rotational wavefront control. The metalens employs two identical nanostructured discs featuring germanium (Ge) meta-atoms on calcium fluoride (CaF2) substrates, operating as birefringent half-wave retarders with 99.95% Polarization Conversion Ratio (PCR) and 83.65% total transmission power at 2 μm wavelength. Full-wave numerical simulations demonstrate continuous focal length tunability from 45 μm to 12 μm by rotating the second disk from 30 deg. to 120 deg., corresponding to the numerical aperture values ranging from 22.99% to 68.67%. The proposed metalens maintains reconfigurable focusing regardless of the incident light polarization, while concurrently enabling polarization-controlled operation via a phase-modulation mechanism that yields inverse responses under Right Circular Polarization (RCP) and Left Circular Polarization (LCP) illuminations.

</details>


### [304] [From random patterns to nanophotonic structures: Electromagnetic field prediction without retraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27769)
*Jiwoo Kim,Mingyu Park,Chanik Kang,Hyewon Suk,Haejun Chung*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该工作用随机介电图案训练电磁代理求解器，实现了对未见几何与材料排布的直接场预测，平均相对场误差1.4%–7.6%，并对逆设计超透镜透射功率给出中位相对误差0.7%–0.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电磁代理求解器可加速纳米光子设计，但推广使用的前提是能对未训练过的几何与材料组合做出准确预测，因此需要验证随机图案训练的可迁移性。

Method: 以空间介电常数分布为网络输入，训练集由5,001个随机自由形状介电图案与140个相对介电常数（2.1–16.0）组合成700,140个样本；采用膨胀残差网络等架构，在训练集之外的多种结构（非周期条阵列、手工图案、逆设计超透镜、逆设计二值结构、双材料自由形状图案）上测试。

Result: 在35,441个几何–介电常数样本上平均相对场误差为1.4%–7.6%；6,950个逆设计超透镜样本中，最优三种架构预测透射功率的中位相对误差为0.7%–0.9%。精度依赖折射率与结构尺度，图案比训练集更粗时误差增大。

Conclusion: 随机图案训练可支持电磁代理在不同结构族间复用，为材料筛选、迭代光学设计与制造容差分析共享训练成本提供基础。

Abstract: Electromagnetic surrogate solvers can accelerate nanophotonic design, but their broader use requires accurate predictions for unseen geometries and material arrangements. Training on random dielectric patterns enables direct prediction of complex electromagnetic fields in diverse two-dimensional nanophotonic structures without retraining. The network takes spatial permittivity distributions as inputs, with training samples drawn from a dataset comprising 700,140 combinations of 5,001 random freeform dielectric patterns and 140 relative permittivities from 2.1 to 16.0. The trained model predicts fields for aperiodic bar arrays, manually defined patterns, inverse-designed metalenses, inverse-designed binary structures, and two-material freeform patterns excluded from training. Across 35,441 geometry-permittivity samples, a dilated residual network achieves average relative field errors of 1.4%-7.6%. For 6,950 inverse-designed metalens samples, the three most accurate architectures predict transmitted power with median relative errors of 0.7%-0.9%. Accuracy depends on refractive index and structural scale, with greater errors for patterns coarser than those used for training. These results demonstrate transfer to independently constructed geometries and to new spatial arrangements of dielectric values not represented in the training. Random-pattern training therefore supports reuse of electromagnetic surrogates across multiple structural families, providing a basis for sharing training costs among material screening, iterative optical design, and fabrication-tolerance analysis.

</details>


### [305] [Controlling exceptional points of layered non-Hermitian structures with magnetic field](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27902)
*Milena Ramanovich,Denis Novitsky*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 通过在损耗层与增益层之间引入磁光材料构建三层PT对称光子结构，利用外磁场诱导的各向异性（偏振敏感反射/透射）调控奇异点，可实现在实际参数下由磁场驱动PT对称破缺与模式交换，并可用于磁场扰动传感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奇异点是非厄米系统的特征，已在光学、声学、电子学等领域广泛应用；本文旨在解决如何用外磁场对奇异点进行有效调控，并探索各向异性（含磁性）材料在可调非厄米光子学中的价值。

Method: 构建典型三层PT对称光子结构，在损耗层与增益层之间夹入磁光材料；施加磁场使系统呈各向异性，产生偏振相关的反射与透射特性，据此分析磁场对PT对称性及模式演化的调控作用。

Result: 磁场可在实际系统参数下诱导PT对称破缺并实现模式交换；该方案可拓展为磁场扰动传感，且所需场强水平易于调节。

Conclusion: 研究证明了各向异性（包括磁性）材料对可调非厄米光子学具有重要价值，为磁场调控奇异点提供了可行途径。

Abstract: Exceptional points are the characteristic features of non-Hermitian systems providing numerous applications in optics, acoustics, electronics, etc. We show that exceptional points can be controlled with the external magnetic field by considering the archetypal three-layered $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric photonic structure including a magneto-optic material between the loss and gain layers. Application of the magnetic field makes the system anisotropic with the polarization-sensitive reflection and transmission properties. As a result, the magnetic field can stimulate $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetry breaking and mode exchange at realistic values of system parameters. Moreover, we suggest that the proposed scheme can be also used for magnetic-perturbation sensing with an easily adaptable level of desired field strength. Our results contain a valuable evidence for the usefulness of anisotropic (including magnetic) materials for tunable non-Hermitian photonics.

</details>


### [306] [Enhanced orbital-angular-momentum dimensionality and spatial-spectral decoupling in thin-film SPDC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28020)
